title: 1 Tarihi 1:1
content: 1 Adamu, Set, Enosh,

title: 1 Tarihi 1:2
content: 2 Kenan, Mahalalel, Yared,

title: 1 Tarihi 1:3
content: 3 Enok, Metusela, Lamek, Nuhu.

title: 1 Tarihi 1:4
content: 4 ’Ya’yan Nuhu maza su ne, Shem, Ham da Yafet.

title: 1 Tarihi 1:5
content: 5 ’Ya’yan Yafet maza su ne, Gomer, Magog, Madai, Yaban, Tubal, Meshek da Tiras.

title: 1 Tarihi 1:6
content: 6 ’Ya’yan Gomer maza su ne, Ashkenaz, Rifat da Togarma.

title: 1 Tarihi 1:7
content: 7 ’Ya’yan Yaban maza su ne, Elisha, Tarshish, Kittim da Rodanim.

title: 1 Tarihi 1:8
content: 8 ’Ya’yan Ham maza su ne, Kush, Masar Fut da Kan’ana.

title: 1 Tarihi 1:9
content: 9 ’Ya’yan Kush maza su ne, Seba, Hawila, Sabta, Ra’ama da Sabteka. ’Ya’yan Ra’ama maza su ne, Sheba da Dedan

title: 1 Tarihi 1:10
content: 10 Kush shi ne mahaifin Nimrod, wanda ya yi girma ya zama babban jarumi a duniya.

title: 1 Tarihi 1:11
content: 11 Masar shi ne mahaifin Ludiyawa, Anamawa, Lehabiyawa, Neftuhawa,

title: 1 Tarihi 1:12
content: 12 Fatrusawa, Kasluhiyawa (daga waɗanda Filistiyawa suka fito) da Kaftorawa.

title: 1 Tarihi 1:13
content: 13 Kan’ana shi ne mahaifin Sidon ɗan farinsa, da Hittiyawa,

title: 1 Tarihi 1:14
content: 14 Yebusiyawa, Amoriyawa, Girgashiyawa

title: 1 Tarihi 1:15
content: 15 Hiwiyawa, Arkiyawa, Siniyawa,

title: 1 Tarihi 1:16
content: 16 Arbadiyawa, Zemarawa da Hamawa.

title: 1 Tarihi 1:17
content: 17 ’Ya’yan Shem maza su ne, Elam, Asshur, Arfakshad, Lud da Aram. ’Ya’yan Aram maza su ne, Uz, Hul, Geter da Meshek.

title: 1 Tarihi 1:18
content: 18 Arfakshad shi ne mahaifin Shela, Shela kuwa shi ne mahaifin Eber.

title: 1 Tarihi 1:19
content: 19 Aka haifa wa Eber ’ya’ya maza biyu. Aka kira ɗaya Feleg domin a lokacinsa ne aka raba duniya; sunan ɗan’uwansa kuwa shi ne Yoktan.

title: 1 Tarihi 1:20
content: 20 Yoktan shi ne mahaifin Almodad, Shelef, Hazarmawet, Yera

title: 1 Tarihi 1:21
content: 21 Hadoram, Uzal, Dikla,

title: 1 Tarihi 1:22
content: 22 Ebal, Abimayel, Sheba,

title: 1 Tarihi 1:23
content: 23 Ofir, Hawila da Yobab. Dukan waɗannan ’ya’yan Yoktan maza ne.

title: 1 Tarihi 1:24
content: 24 Shem, Arfakshad, Shela,

title: 1 Tarihi 1:25
content: 25 Eber, Feleg, Reyu

title: 1 Tarihi 1:26
content: 26 Serug, Nahor, Tera

title: 1 Tarihi 1:27
content: 27 da Abram (wato, Ibrahim).

title: 1 Tarihi 1:28
content: 28 ’Ya’yan Ibrahim maza su ne, Ishaku da Ishmayel.

title: 1 Tarihi 1:29
content: 29 Waɗannan su ne zuriyarsu. Nebayiwot ɗan farin Ishmayel, Kedar, Adbeyel, Mibsam,

title: 1 Tarihi 1:30
content: 30 Mishma, Duma, Massa, Hadad, Tema

title: 1 Tarihi 1:31
content: 31 Yetur, Nafish da Kedema. Waɗannan su ne ’ya’yan Ishmayel maza.

title: 1 Tarihi 1:32
content: 32 ’Ya’yan Ketura maza, ƙwarƙwarar Ibrahim su ne, Zimran, Yokshan, Medan, Midiyan, Ishbak da Shuwa. ’Ya’yan Yokshan maza su ne, Sheba da Dedan.

title: 1 Tarihi 1:33
content: 33 ’Ya’yan Midiyan maza su ne, Efa, Efer, Hanok, Abida da Elda’a. Dukan waɗannan su ne zuriyar Ketura.

title: 1 Tarihi 1:34
content: 34 Ibrahim shi ne mahaifin Ishaku. ’Ya’yan Ishaku maza su ne, Isuwa da Isra’ila.

title: 1 Tarihi 1:35
content: 35 ’Ya’yan Isuwa maza, su ne, Elifaz, Reyuwel, Yewush, Yalam da Kora

title: 1 Tarihi 1:36
content: 36 ’Ya’yan Elifaz maza su ne, Teman, Omar, Zefi, Gatam, Kenaz, da Timna wanda aka haifa wa Amalek.

title: 1 Tarihi 1:37
content: 37 ’Ya’yan maza Reyuwel su ne, Nahat, Zera, Shamma da Mizza.

title: 1 Tarihi 1:38
content: 38 ’Ya’yan Seyir maza su ne, Lotan, Shobal, Zibeyon, Ana, Dishon, Ezer da Dishan.

title: 1 Tarihi 1:39
content: 39 ’Ya’yan Lotan maza su ne, Hori da Homam. Timna ita ce ’yar’uwar Lotan.

title: 1 Tarihi 1:40
content: 40 ’Ya’yan Shobal maza su ne, Alwan, Manahat, Ebal, Shefo da Onam. ’Ya’yan Zibeyon maza su ne, Aiya da Ana.

title: 1 Tarihi 1:41
content: 41 Ɗan Ana shi ne, Dishon. ’Ya’yan Dishon maza su ne, Hemdan, Eshban, Itran da Keran.

title: 1 Tarihi 1:42
content: 42 ’Ya’yan Ezer maza su ne, Bilhan, Za’aban da Ya’akan. ’Ya’yan Dishan maza su ne, Uz da Aran.

title: 1 Tarihi 1:43
content: 43 Waɗannan su ne sarakunan da suka yi sarauta a Edom kafin wani sarkin mutumin Isra’ila yă yi sarauta. Bela ɗan Beyor, wanda aka kira birninsa Dinhaba.

title: 1 Tarihi 1:44
content: 44 Sa’ad da Bela ya mutu sai Yobab ɗan Zera daga Bozra ya gāje shi a matsayin sarki.

title: 1 Tarihi 1:45
content: 45 Da Yobab ya mutu, Husham daga ƙasar Temaniyawa ya gāje shi a matsayin sarki.

title: 1 Tarihi 1:46
content: 46 Sa’ad da Husham ya mutu, Hadad ɗan Bedad, wanda ya ci Midiyan da yaƙi a cikin ƙasar Mowab, ya gāje shi a matsayin sarki. Aka kira birninsa Awit.

title: 1 Tarihi 1:47
content: 47 Da Hadad ya mutu, Samla daga Masreka ya gāje shi a matsayin sarki.

title: 1 Tarihi 1:48
content: 48 Sa’ad da Samla ya mutu, Sha’ul daga Rehobot na kogi ya gāje shi a matsayin sarki.

title: 1 Tarihi 1:49
content: 49 Sa’ad da Sha’ul ya mutu, Ba’al-Hanan ɗan Akbor ya gāje shi a matsayin sarki.

title: 1 Tarihi 1:50
content: 50 Sa’ad da Ba’al-Hanan ya mutu, Hadad ya gāje shi a matsayin sarki. Aka kira birninsa Fau, sunan matarsa kuwa Mehetabel ’yar Matired, ’yar Me-Zahab.

title: 1 Tarihi 1:51
content: 51 Hadad shi ma ya mutu. Manyan Edom su ne, Timna, Alwa, Yetet

title: 1 Tarihi 1:52
content: 52 Oholibama, Ela, Finon

title: 1 Tarihi 1:53
content: 53 Kenaz, Teman, Mibzar,

title: 1 Tarihi 1:54
content: 54 Magdiyel da Iram. Waɗannan su ne manyan Edom.

title: 1 Tarihi 2:1
content: 1 Waɗannan su ne ’ya’yan Isra’ila maza. Ruben, Simeyon, Lawi, Yahuda, Issakar, Zebulun,

title: 1 Tarihi 2:2
content: 2 Dan, Yusuf, Benyamin, Naftali, Gad da Asher.

title: 1 Tarihi 2:3
content: 3 ’Ya’yan Yahuda maza su ne, Er, Onan da Shela. Waɗannan mutum uku Bat-shuwa mutuniyar Kan’ana ce ta haifa masa. Er, ɗan farin Yahuda mugu ne a gaban Ubangiji, saboda haka Ubangiji ya kashe shi.

title: 1 Tarihi 2:4
content: 4 Tamar, surukar Yahuda, ta haifa masa Ferez da Zera. Yahuda ya haifi ’ya’ya maza biyar ne.

title: 1 Tarihi 2:5
content: 5 ’Ya’yan Ferez maza su ne, Hezron da Hamul.

title: 1 Tarihi 2:6
content: 6 ’Ya’yan Zera maza su ne, Zimri, Etan, Heman, Kalkol da Darda, su biyar ne.

title: 1 Tarihi 2:7
content: 7 ’Ya’yan Karmi maza su ne, Akar wanda ya kawo masifa wa Isra’ila ta wurin yin abin da aka haramta.

title: 1 Tarihi 2:8
content: 8 Ɗan Etan shi ne, Azariya.

title: 1 Tarihi 2:9
content: 9 ’Ya’ya maza da aka haifa wa Hezron su ne, Yerameyel, Ram da Kaleb.

title: 1 Tarihi 2:10
content: 10 Ram shi ne mahaifin Amminadab, Amminadab kuwa shi ne mahaifin Nashon, shugaban mutanen Yahuda.

title: 1 Tarihi 2:11
content: 11 Nashon shi ne mahaifin Salma, Salma shi ne mahaifin Bowaz,

title: 1 Tarihi 2:12
content: 12 Bowaz shi ne mahaifin Obed kuma Obed shi ne mahaifin Yesse.

title: 1 Tarihi 2:13
content: 13 Yesse shi ne mahaifin. Eliyab ɗan farinsa, ɗansa na biyu shi ne Abinadab, na ukun Shimeya,

title: 1 Tarihi 2:14
content: 14 na huɗun Netanel, na biyar Raddai,

title: 1 Tarihi 2:15
content: 15 na shidan Ozem na bakwai kuma Dawuda.

title: 1 Tarihi 2:16
content: 16 ’Yan’uwansu mata su ne Zeruhiya da Abigiyel. ’Ya’yan Zeruhiya maza guda uku su ne Abishai, Yowab da Asahel.

title: 1 Tarihi 2:17
content: 17 Abigiyel ita ce mahaifiyar Amasa, wanda mahaifinsa shi ne Yeter mutumin Ishmayel.

title: 1 Tarihi 2:18
content: 18 Kaleb ɗan Hezron ya haifi yara ta wurin matarsa Azuba (da kuma ta wurin Yeriyot). Waɗannan su ne ’ya’yan Azuba maza. Yesher, Shobab da Ardon.

title: 1 Tarihi 2:19
content: 19 Da Azuba ta mutu, Kaleb ya auri Efrat, wadda ta haifa masa Hur.

title: 1 Tarihi 2:20
content: 20 Hur shi ne mahaifin Uri, Uri kuma shi ne mahaifin Bezalel.

title: 1 Tarihi 2:21
content: 21 Daga baya, Hezron ya kwana da ’yar Makir mahaifin Gileyad (ya aure ta sa’ad da take da shekara sittin), ta haifa masa Segub.

title: 1 Tarihi 2:22
content: 22 Segub shi ne mahaifin Yayir, wanda ya yi mulkin garuruwa uku a Gileyad.

title: 1 Tarihi 2:23
content: 23 (Amma Geshur da Aram suka ƙwace Hawwot Yayir da kuma Kenat tare da ƙauyukan kewayenta, garuruwa sittin.) Dukan waɗannan su ne zuriyar Makir mahaifin Gileyad.

title: 1 Tarihi 2:24
content: 24 Bayan Hezron ya mutu a Kaleb Efrata, sai Abiya matar Hezron ta haifa masa Asshur mahaifin Tekowa.

title: 1 Tarihi 2:25
content: 25 ’Ya’yan Yerameyel maza, ɗan farin Hezron su ne, Ram shi ne ɗan fari, sai Buna, Oren, Ozem da Ahiya.

title: 1 Tarihi 2:26
content: 26 Yerameyel yana da wata mata, wadda sunanta Atara; ita ce mahaifiyar Onam.

title: 1 Tarihi 2:27
content: 27 ’Ya’yan Ram maza ɗan farin Yerameyel su ne, Ma’az, Yamin da Eker.

title: 1 Tarihi 2:28
content: 28 ’Ya’yan Onam maza su ne, Shammai da Yada. ’Ya’yan Shammai maza su ne, Nadab da Abishur.

title: 1 Tarihi 2:29
content: 29 Sunan matar Abishur ita ce Abihayil, wadda ta haifa masa Aban da Molid.

title: 1 Tarihi 2:30
content: 30 ’Ya’yan Nadab maza su ne, Seled da Affayim. Seled ya mutu babu yara.

title: 1 Tarihi 2:31
content: 31 Ɗan Affayim shi ne, Ishi, wanda shi ne mahaifin Sheshan. Sheshan shi ne mahaifin Alai.

title: 1 Tarihi 2:32
content: 32 ’Ya’yan Yada maza, ɗan’uwan Shammai su ne, Yeter da Yonatan. Yeter ya mutu babu yara.

title: 1 Tarihi 2:33
content: 33 ’Ya’yan Yonatan maza su ne, Felet da Zaza. Waɗannan su ne zuriyar Yerameyel.

title: 1 Tarihi 2:34
content: 34 Sheshan ba shi da ’ya’ya maza, sai ’ya’ya mata kawai. Yana da bawa mutumin Masar mai suna Yarha.

title: 1 Tarihi 2:35
content: 35 Sheshan ya ba da ’yarsa aure ga bawansa Yarha, ta kuwa haifa masa Attai.

title: 1 Tarihi 2:36
content: 36 Attai shi ne mahaifin Natan, Natan shi ne mahaifin Zabad,

title: 1 Tarihi 2:37
content: 37 Zabad shi ne mahaifin Eflal, Eflal shi ne mahaifin Obed,

title: 1 Tarihi 2:38
content: 38 Obed shi ne mahaifin Yehu, Yehu shi ne mahaifin Azariya,

title: 1 Tarihi 2:39
content: 39 Azariya shi ne mahaifin Helez, Helez shi ne mahaifin Eleyasa,

title: 1 Tarihi 2:40
content: 40 Eleyasa shi ne mahaifin Sismai, Sismai shi ne mahaifin Shallum

title: 1 Tarihi 2:41
content: 41 Shallum shi ne mahaifin Yekamiya, Yekamiya kuma shi ne mahaifin Elishama.

title: 1 Tarihi 2:42
content: 42 ’Ya’yan Kaleb maza, ɗan’uwan Yerameyel su ne, Mesha ɗan farinsa, wanda shi ne mahaifin Zif, da ɗansa Maresha, wanda shi ne mahaifin Hebron.

title: 1 Tarihi 2:43
content: 43 ’Ya’yan Hebron maza su ne, Kora, Taffuwa, Rekem da Shema.

title: 1 Tarihi 2:44
content: 44 Shema shi ne mahaifin Raham, Raham kuma shi ne mahaifin Yorkeyam. Rekem shi ne mahaifin Shammai.

title: 1 Tarihi 2:45
content: 45 Ɗan Shammai shi ne Mawon, Mawon kuma shi ne mahaifin Bet-Zur.

title: 1 Tarihi 2:46
content: 46 Efa ƙwarƙwarar Kaleb ita ce mahaifiyar Haran, Moza da Gazez. Haran shi ne mahaifin Gazez.

title: 1 Tarihi 2:47
content: 47 ’Ya’yan Yadai maza su ne, Regem, Yotam, Geshan, Felet, Efa da Sha’af.

title: 1 Tarihi 2:48
content: 48 Ma’aka ƙwarƙwarar Kaleb ita ce mahaifiyar Sheber da Tirhana.

title: 1 Tarihi 2:49
content: 49 Ta kuma haifi Sha’af mahaifin Madmanna da kuma Shewa, mahaifin Makbena da Gibeya. ’Yar Kaleb ita ce Aksa.

title: 1 Tarihi 2:50
content: 50 Waɗannan su ne zuriyar Kaleb. ’Ya’yan Hur maza, ɗan farin Efrata su ne, Shobal mahaifin Kiriyat Yeyarim,

title: 1 Tarihi 2:51
content: 51 Salma mahaifin Betlehem, da kuma Haref mahaifin Bet-Gader.

title: 1 Tarihi 2:52
content: 52 Zuriyar Shobal mahaifin Kiriyat Yeyarim su ne, Harowe, rabin Manahatiyawa,

title: 1 Tarihi 2:53
content: 53 kuma gidan Kiriyat Yeyarim su ne, Itrayawa, Futiyawa, Shumatiyawa da Mishratiyawa. Daga waɗannan ne Zoratiyawa da Eshtawoliyawa suka fito.

title: 1 Tarihi 2:54
content: 54 Zuriyar Salma su ne, Betlehem, Netofawa, Atrot Bet Yowab, rabin Manahatiyawa, Zoriyawa,

title: 1 Tarihi 2:55
content: 55 kuma gidan marubuta waɗanda suke zama a Yabez su ne, Tiratiyawa, Shimeyatiyawa da Sukatiyawa. Waɗannan su ne Keniyawa waɗanda suka zo daga Hammat, mahaifin gidan Rekab.

title: 1 Tarihi 3:1
content: 1 Waɗannan su ne ’ya’yan Dawuda maza da aka haifa masa a Hebron. Ɗan farinsa shi ne Amnon ɗan Ahinowam mutuniyar Yezireyel; na biyun, Daniyel ɗan Abigiyel mutuniyar Karmel;

title: 1 Tarihi 3:2
content: 2 na ukun, Absalom ɗan Ma’aka ’yar Talmai sarkin Geshur; na huɗun, Adoniya ɗan Haggit;

title: 1 Tarihi 3:3
content: 3 na biyar, Shefatiya ɗan Abital; da kuma na shida, Itireyam ta wurin matarsa Egla.

title: 1 Tarihi 3:4
content: 4 Waɗannan su ne aka haifa wa Dawuda a Hebron, inda ya yi mulki shekaru bakwai da wata shida. Dawuda ya yi mulki a Urushalima shekaru talatin da uku,

title: 1 Tarihi 3:5
content: 5 kuma waɗannan su ne yaran da aka haifa masa a can. Shimeya, Shobab, Natan da Solomon. Waɗannan huɗu ne Bat-shuwa ’yar Ammiyel ta haifa.

title: 1 Tarihi 3:6
content: 6 Akwai kuma Ibhar, Elishama, Elifelet,

title: 1 Tarihi 3:7
content: 7 Noga, Nefeg, Yafiya,

title: 1 Tarihi 3:8
content: 8 Elishama, Eliyada da Elifelet, su tara ne duka.

title: 1 Tarihi 3:9
content: 9 Dukan waɗannan ’ya’yan Dawuda ne maza, ban da ’ya’yansa maza ta wurin ƙwarƙwaransa. Tamar ita ce ’yar’uwarsu.

title: 1 Tarihi 3:10
content: 10 Zuriyar Solomon su ne Rehobowam, da Abiya, da Asa, da Yehoshafat,

title: 1 Tarihi 3:11
content: 11 da Yoram, da Ahaziya, da Yowash,

title: 1 Tarihi 3:12
content: 12 da Amaziya, da Azariya, da Yotam,

title: 1 Tarihi 3:13
content: 13 da Ahaz, da Hezekiya da Manasse,

title: 1 Tarihi 3:14
content: 14 da Amon, da Yosiya.

title: 1 Tarihi 3:15
content: 15 ’Ya’yan Yosiya maza su ne, Yohanan ɗan fari, Yehohiyakim ɗa na biyu, Zedekiya ɗa na uku Shallum ɗa na huɗu.

title: 1 Tarihi 3:16
content: 16 Magādan Yehohiyakim su ne, Yekoniya ɗansa, da Zedekiya.

title: 1 Tarihi 3:17
content: 17 Zuriyar Yekoniya kamamme su ne, Sheyaltiyel,

title: 1 Tarihi 3:18
content: 18 Malkiram, Fedahiya, Shenazzar, Yekamiya, Hoshama da Nedabiya.

title: 1 Tarihi 3:19
content: 19 ’Ya’yan Fedahiya su ne, Zerubbabel da Shimeyi. ’Ya’yan Zerubbabel maza su ne, Meshullam da Hananiya. Shelomit ce ’yar’uwarsu.

title: 1 Tarihi 3:20
content: 20 Akwai kuma waɗansu biyar, Hashuba, Ohel, Berekiya, Hasadiya da Yushab-Hesed.

title: 1 Tarihi 3:21
content: 21 Zuriyar Hananiya su ne, Felatiya da Yeshahiya, Refahiya, Arnan, Obadiya da Shekaniya.

title: 1 Tarihi 3:22
content: 22 Zuriyar Shekaniya su ne, Shemahiya da ’ya’yansa maza. Hattush, Igal, Bariya, Neyariya da Shafat, su shida ne duka.

title: 1 Tarihi 3:23
content: 23 ’Ya’yan Neyariya maza su ne, Eliyohenai, Hezekiya da Azrikam, su uku ne duka.

title: 1 Tarihi 3:24
content: 24 ’Ya’yan Eliyohenai su ne, Hodawiya, Eliyashib, Felahiya, Akkub, Yohanan, Delahiya da Anani, su bakwai ne duka.

title: 1 Tarihi 4:1
content: 1 Zuriyoyin Yahuda su ne, Ferez, Hezron, Karmi, Hur da Shobal.

title: 1 Tarihi 4:2
content: 2 Reyahiya ɗan Shobal shi ne mahaifin Yahat, Yahat shi ne mahaifin Ahumai da Lahad. Waɗannan su ne gidajen Zoratiyawa.

title: 1 Tarihi 4:3
content: 3 Waɗannan su ne ’ya’yan Etam. Yezireyel, Ishma da Idbash. ’Yar’uwarsu ita ce Hazzelelfoni.

title: 1 Tarihi 4:4
content: 4 Fenuwel shi ne mahaifin Gedor, kuma Ezer shi ne mahaifin Husha. Waɗannan su ne zuriyar Hur, ɗan farin Efrata da mahaifin Betlehem.

title: 1 Tarihi 4:5
content: 5 Asshur mahaifin Tekowa yana da mata biyu, Hela da Na’ara.

title: 1 Tarihi 4:6
content: 6 Na’ara ta haifi Ahuzzam, Hefer, Temeni da Hawahashtari. Waɗannan su ne zuriyar Na’ara.

title: 1 Tarihi 4:7
content: 7 ’Ya’yan Hela maza su ne, Zeret, Zohar, Etnan,

title: 1 Tarihi 4:8
content: 8 da Koz. Koz ne mahaifin Anub da Hazzobeba, shi ne kuma kakan iyalin da suka fito daga zuriyar Aharhel ɗan Harum.

title: 1 Tarihi 4:9
content: 9 Yabez ya fi ’yan’uwansa martaba. Mahaifiyarsa ta sa masa suna Yabez, tana cewa, “Na haife shi da azaba.”

title: 1 Tarihi 4:10
content: 10 Yabez ya yi kuka ga Allah na Isra’ila ya ce, “Ka yi mini albarka ka fadada yankina! Bari hannunka yă kasance tare da ni, yă kuma kiyaye ni daga abin da zai cuce ni, don kada in shiga wahala.” Sai Allah ya ji roƙonsa.

title: 1 Tarihi 4:11
content: 11 Kelub, ɗan’uwan Shuha, shi ne mahaifin Mehir, wanda shi ne mahaifin Eshton.

title: 1 Tarihi 4:12
content: 12 Eshton shi ne mahaifin Bet-Rafa, Faseya da Tehinna wanda ya haifi Ir Nahash. Waɗannan su ne mutanen Reka.

title: 1 Tarihi 4:13
content: 13 ’Ya’yan Kenaz maza su ne, Otniyel da Serahiya. ’Ya’yan Otniyel maza su ne, Hatat da Meyonotai.

title: 1 Tarihi 4:14
content: 14 Meyonotai shi ne mahaifin Ofra. Serahiya shi ne mahaifin Yowab, mahaifin Ge-Harashim. An kira shi haka domin mutanensa masu sana’ar hannu ne.

title: 1 Tarihi 4:15
content: 15 ’Ya’yan Kaleb ɗan Yefunne maza su ne, Iru, Ela da Na’am. Ɗan Ela shi ne, Kenaz.

title: 1 Tarihi 4:16
content: 16 ’Ya’yan Yahallelel su ne, Zif, Zifa, Tiriya da Asarel.

title: 1 Tarihi 4:17
content: 17 ’Ya’yan Ezra maza su ne, Yeter, Mered, Efer da Yalon. Ɗaya daga cikin matan Mered ta haifi Miriyam, Shammai da Ishba wanda ya haifi Eshtemowa.

title: 1 Tarihi 4:18
content: 18 (Matarsa mutuniyar Yahuda kuwa ta haifi Yared mahaifin Gedor, Heber mahaifin Soko, da kuma Yekutiyel mahaifin Zanowa.) Waɗannan su ne ’ya’yan Bitiya ’yar Fir’auna, wadda Mered ya aura.

title: 1 Tarihi 4:19
content: 19 ’Ya’yan matar Hodiya, ’yar’uwar Naham su ne, suka haifi Keyila Bagarme, da Eshtemowa mutumin Ma’aka.

title: 1 Tarihi 4:20
content: 20 ’Ya’yan Shimon maza su ne, Amnon, Rinna, Ben-Hanan da Tilon. Zuriyar Ishi su ne, Zohet da Ben-Zohet.

title: 1 Tarihi 4:21
content: 21 ’Ya’yan Shela ɗan Yahuda maza su ne, Er mahaifin Leka, La’ada mahaifin Maresha da kuma gidajen masu aikin lilin a Bet-Ashbeya,

title: 1 Tarihi 4:22
content: 22 da Yokim, mutanen Kozeba, da Yowash da Saraf wanda ya yi mulkin Mowab da kuma Yashubi Lehem (Waɗannan rubutattun tarihi ne na tun dā.)

title: 1 Tarihi 4:23
content: 23 Su ne maginan tukwane waɗanda suka zauna a Netayim da Gedera; sun zauna a can suka kuma yi wa sarki aiki.

title: 1 Tarihi 4:24
content: 24 Zuriyar Simeyon su ne, Nemuwel, Yamin, Yarib, Zera da Shawulu;

title: 1 Tarihi 4:25
content: 25 Shawulu ya haifi Shallum, Shallum ya haifi Mibsam. Mibsam ya haifi Mishma.

title: 1 Tarihi 4:26
content: 26 Zuriyar Mishma su ne, Hammuwel ɗansa, wanda ya haifi Zakkur, shi Zakkur kuma ya haifi Shimeyi.

title: 1 Tarihi 4:27
content: 27 Shimeyi yana da ’ya’ya maza goma sha shida da ’ya’ya mata shida, amma ’yan’uwansa ba su da ’ya’ya da yawa; saboda haka gidansu gaba ɗaya ba tă zama mai mutane da yawa kamar mutanen Yahuda ba.

title: 1 Tarihi 4:28
content: 28 Sun zauna a Beyersheba, Molada, Hazar Shuwal,

title: 1 Tarihi 4:29
content: 29 Bilha, Ezem, Tolad

title: 1 Tarihi 4:30
content: 30 Betuwel, Horma, Ziklag,

title: 1 Tarihi 4:31
content: 31 Bet-Markabot, Hazar-Susim, Bet-Biri da Sha’arayim. Waɗannan su ne garuruwansu har lokacin mulkin Dawuda.

title: 1 Tarihi 4:32
content: 32 Ƙauyukan da suke kewayensu su ne Etam, Ayin, Rimmon, Token da Ashan, garuruwa biyar;

title: 1 Tarihi 4:33
content: 33 da kuma dukan ƙauyuka kewaye da waɗannan garuruwa har zuwa Ba’al. Waɗannan ne wuraren zamansu. Suka kuma ajiye tarihin zuriya.

title: 1 Tarihi 4:34
content: 34 Zuriyar Simeyon ta ƙunshi Meshobab, da Yamlek, da Yosha ɗan Amaziya.

title: 1 Tarihi 4:35
content: 35 Akwai Yowel, da Yehu ɗan Yoshibiya. Yoshibiya ɗan Seraya ne. Serahiya kuma ɗan Asiyel ne.

title: 1 Tarihi 4:36
content: 36 Akwai Eliyohenai da Ya’akoba, da Yeshohahiya, da Asahiya, da Adiyel, da Yesimiyel, da Benahiya.

title: 1 Tarihi 4:37
content: 37 Akwai Ziza ɗan Shifi. Shifi ɗan Allon ne. Allon ɗan Yedahiya ne. Yedahiya ɗan Shimri ne. Shimri kuma ɗan Shemahiya ne.

title: 1 Tarihi 4:38
content: 38 Mutanen da aka jera sunayensu a bisa, shugabannin gidajensu ne. Iyalansu sun ƙaru sosai,

title: 1 Tarihi 4:39
content: 39 suka tafi bayan garin Gedor wajajen gabashin kwari suna neman makiyaya domin garkunansu.

title: 1 Tarihi 4:40
content: 40 Suka sami makiyaya mai ciyawa mai kyau, ƙasar kuma tana da fāɗi, da salama, kuma zaman lafiya. A dā waɗansu mutanen Ham sun zauna a can.

title: 1 Tarihi 4:41
content: 41 Mutanen da aka jera sunayensu sun zo ne a zamanin Hezekiya sarkin Yahuda. Suka yaƙi mutanen Ham a wuraren zamansu, haka kuma suka yi da Meyunawa da suke can, suka hallaka su ƙaƙaf, yadda yake har yă zuwa yau. Sa’an nan suka zauna a wurin, gama akwai makiyaya domin garkunansu.

title: 1 Tarihi 4:42
content: 42 Mutum ɗari biyar na waɗannan mutane Simeyon, waɗanda Felatiya, Neyariya, Refahiya da Uzziyel, ’ya’yan Ishi maza suka jagorance, sun mamaye ƙasar tudu ta Seyir.

title: 1 Tarihi 4:43
content: 43 Suka karkashe raguwar Amalekawan da suka tsere, suka kuma zauna a can har yă zuwa yau.

title: 1 Tarihi 5:1
content: 1 ’Ya’yan Ruben maza ɗan farin Isra’ila (shi ne ɗan fari, amma sa’ad da ya ƙazantar da gadon auren mahaifinsa, sai aka ba wa ’yancin ɗan farinsa wa ’ya’yan Yusuf maza ɗan Isra’ila; don kada a lissafta shi a tarihin zuriya bisa ga matsayin haihuwarsa,

title: 1 Tarihi 5:2
content: 2 ko da yake Yahuda shi ne mafi ƙarfi cikin ’yan’uwansa kuma mai mulki ya fito daga gare shi, ’yancin zaman ɗan fari na Yusuf ne),

title: 1 Tarihi 5:3
content: 3 ’ya’yan Ruben ɗan farin Isra’ila maza su ne, Hanok, Fallu, Hezron da Karmi.

title: 1 Tarihi 5:4
content: 4 Zuriyar Yowel su ne, Shemahiya, Gog, Shimeyi,

title: 1 Tarihi 5:5
content: 5 Mika, Reyahiya, Ba’al,

title: 1 Tarihi 5:6
content: 6 da Beyera, wanda Tiglat-Fileser sarkin Assuriya ya ɗauka zuwa zaman bauta. Beyera shi ne shugaban mutanen Ruben.

title: 1 Tarihi 5:7
content: 7 Danginsu bisa ga iyalansu da aka jera bisa ga tarihin zuriyarsu su ne, Yehiyel shi ne sarki, akwai Zakariya,

title: 1 Tarihi 5:8
content: 8 da Bela ɗan Azaz. Azaz ɗan Shema daga dangin Yowel. Yowel ya yi zama a yankin Arower har zuwa Nebo da Ba’al-Meyon.

title: 1 Tarihi 5:9
content: 9 Ta waje gabas sun zauna a ƙasar har zuwa bakin hamadan da ya nausa zuwa Kogin Yuferites, domin dabbobinsu sun ƙaru a Gileyad.

title: 1 Tarihi 5:10
content: 10 A zamanin Shawulu zuriyar Ruben sun yi yaƙi da Hagirawa, suka ci su da yaƙi, suka zauna a wuraren zaman Hagirawan ko’ina a dukan yankin gabashin Gileyad.

title: 1 Tarihi 5:11
content: 11 Mutanen Gad sun zauna kusa da mutanen Ruben a Bashan, har zuwa Saleka.

title: 1 Tarihi 5:12
content: 12 Yowel shi ne babba, sai Shafan na biyu, sa’an nan Yanai da Shafat, su ne tushen Bashan.

title: 1 Tarihi 5:13
content: 13 Danginsu, bisa ga iyalai su ne, Mika’ilu, Meshullam, Sheba, Yorai, Yakan, Ziya da Eber, su bakwai ne duka.

title: 1 Tarihi 5:14
content: 14 Waɗannan su ne ’ya’yan Abihayil ɗan Huri, ɗan Yarowa, ɗan Gileyad, ɗan Mika’ilu, ɗan Yeshishai, ɗan Yado, ɗan Buz.

title: 1 Tarihi 5:15
content: 15 Ahi ɗan Abiyel, ɗan Guni, shi ne kan iyalinsu.

title: 1 Tarihi 5:16
content: 16 Mutanen Gad sun zauna a Bashan da ƙauyukan da suke kurkusa da shi, da kuma a dukan makiyayan Sharon har zuwa iyaka inda suka kai.

title: 1 Tarihi 5:17
content: 17 Dukan waɗannan sun shiga tarihin zuriya a lokacin mulkin Yotam sarkin Yahuda da Yerobowam sarkin Isra’ila.

title: 1 Tarihi 5:18
content: 18 Mutanen Ruben, mutanen Gad da rabin kabilar Manasse sun kasance da mutane 44,760 shiryayyu don aikin soja, jarumawan da za su iya riƙe garkuwa da takobi, waɗanda suke iya yin amfani da baka, waɗanda kuma aka horar don yaƙi.

title: 1 Tarihi 5:19
content: 19 Suka yi yaƙi da Hagirawa, Yetur, Nafish da Nodab.

title: 1 Tarihi 5:20
content: 20 Aka taimake su a yaƙin, Allah kuma ya ba da Hagirawa da dukan abokansu gare su, domin sun yi kuka gare shi a lokacin yaƙin. Ya amsa addu’o’insu, domin sun dogara gare shi.

title: 1 Tarihi 5:21
content: 21 Suka ƙwace dabbobin Hagirawa, raƙuma dubu hamsin, tumaki dubu ɗari biyu da hamsin da kuma jakuna dubu biyu. Suka kuma kame mutane dubu ɗari ɗaya,

title: 1 Tarihi 5:22
content: 22 waɗansu suka mutu, domin yaƙin na Allah ne. Suka zauna a ƙasar har lokacin da aka kai su zaman bauta.

title: 1 Tarihi 5:23
content: 23 Mutanen rabin kabilar Manasse sun yi yawa; suka zauna a ƙasar daga Bashan har zuwa Ba’al-Hermon, wato, zuwa Senir (Dutsen Hermon).

title: 1 Tarihi 5:24
content: 24 Waɗannan su ne kawunan iyalansu. Efer, Ishi, Eliyel, Azriyel, Irmiya, Hodawiya da Yadiyel. Su jarumawa ne, sanannu, su ne kuma kawunan iyalansu.

title: 1 Tarihi 5:25
content: 25 Amma ba su yi aminci da Allahn kakanninsu ba, suka kuma yi karuwanci ga waɗansu allolin mutanen ƙasar, waɗanda Allah ya hallaka a gabansu.

title: 1 Tarihi 5:26
content: 26 Saboda haka Allah na Isra’ila ya zuga ruhun Ful sarkin Assuriya (wato, Tiglat-Fileser sarkin Assuriya), wanda ya kwashe mutanen Ruben, mutanen Gad da rabin kabilar Manasse zuwa zaman bauta. Ya kwashe su zuwa Hala, Habor, Hara da kuma kogin Gozan, inda suke har wa yau.

title: 1 Tarihi 6:1
content: 1 ’Ya’yan Lawi maza su ne, Gershon, Kohat da Merari.

title: 1 Tarihi 6:2
content: 2 ’Ya’yan Kohat maza su ne, Amram, Izhar, Hebron da Uzziyel.

title: 1 Tarihi 6:3
content: 3 Yaran Amram su ne, Haruna, Musa da Miriyam. ’Ya’yan Haruna maza su ne, Nadab, Abihu, Eleyazar da Itamar.

title: 1 Tarihi 6:4
content: 4 Eleyazar shi ne mahaifin Finehas, Finehas mahaifin Abishuwa,

title: 1 Tarihi 6:5
content: 5 Abishuwa mahaifin Bukki, Bukki mahaifin Uzzi,

title: 1 Tarihi 6:6
content: 6 Uzzi mahaifin Zerahiya, Zerahiya mahaifin Merahiyot,

title: 1 Tarihi 6:7
content: 7 Merahiyot mahaifin Amariya, Amariya mahaifin Ahitub,

title: 1 Tarihi 6:8
content: 8 Ahitub mahaifin Zadok, Zadok mahaifin Ahimawaz,

title: 1 Tarihi 6:9
content: 9 Ahimawaz mahaifin Azariya, Azariya mahaifin Yohanan,

title: 1 Tarihi 6:10
content: 10 Yohanan mahaifin Azariya (shi ne ya yi hidima a matsayin firist a haikalin da Solomon ya gina a Urushalima),

title: 1 Tarihi 6:11
content: 11 Azariya mahaifin Amariya, Amariya mahaifin Ahitub,

title: 1 Tarihi 6:12
content: 12 Ahitub mahaifin Zadok, Zadok mahaifin Shallum,

title: 1 Tarihi 6:13
content: 13 Shallum mahaifin Hilkiya, Hilkiya mahaifin Azariya,

title: 1 Tarihi 6:14
content: 14 Azariya mahaifin Serahiya, Serahiya kuwa mahaifin Yehozadak.

title: 1 Tarihi 6:15
content: 15 Yehozadak ne aka ɗauka sa’ad da Ubangiji ya tura Yahuda da Urushalima zuwa zaman bauta ta hannun Nebukadnezzar.

title: 1 Tarihi 6:16
content: 16 ’Ya’yan Lawi maza su ne, Gershom, Kohat da Merari.

title: 1 Tarihi 6:17
content: 17 Waɗannan su ne sunayen ’ya’yan Gershom. Libni da Shimeyi.

title: 1 Tarihi 6:18
content: 18 ’Ya’yan Kohat maza su ne, Amram, Izhar, Hebron da Uzziyel.

title: 1 Tarihi 6:19
content: 19 ’Ya’yan Merari maza su ne, Mali da Mushi. Waɗannan suke gidajen Lawiyawan da aka jera bisa ga kakanninsu.

title: 1 Tarihi 6:20
content: 20 Na Gershom su ne, Libni, Yahat, Zimma,

title: 1 Tarihi 6:21
content: 21 Yowa, Iddo, Zera da Yeyaterai.

title: 1 Tarihi 6:22
content: 22 Zuriyar Kohat su ne, Amminadab, Kora, Assir,

title: 1 Tarihi 6:23
content: 23 Elkana, Ebiyasaf, Assir,

title: 1 Tarihi 6:24
content: 24 Tahat, Uriyel, Uzziya da Shawulu.

title: 1 Tarihi 6:25
content: 25 Zuriyar Elkana su ne, Amasai, Ahimot,

title: 1 Tarihi 6:26
content: 26 Elkana, Zofai, Nahat,

title: 1 Tarihi 6:27
content: 27 Eliyab Yeroham, Elkana da Sama’ila.

title: 1 Tarihi 6:28
content: 28 ’Ya’yan Sama’ila maza su ne, Yowel ɗan fari da Abiya ɗa na biyu.

title: 1 Tarihi 6:29
content: 29 Zuriyar Merari su ne, Mali, Libni, Shimeyi, Uzza,

title: 1 Tarihi 6:30
content: 30 Shimeya, Haggiya da Asahiya.

title: 1 Tarihi 6:31
content: 31 Waɗannan su ne mutanen da Dawuda ya sa su lura da waƙa a cikin gidan Ubangiji bayan da aka kawo akwatin alkawari yă huta a can.

title: 1 Tarihi 6:32
content: 32 Suka yi hidima da waƙa a gaban tabanakul, Tentin Sujada, sai da Solomon ya gina haikalin Ubangiji a Urushalima. Suka yi ayyukansu bisa ga ƙa’idodin da aka shimfiɗa musu.

title: 1 Tarihi 6:33
content: 33 Ga mutanen da suka yi hidimar, tare da ’ya’yansu maza. Daga mutanen Kohat akwai, Heman, mawaƙi ɗan Yowel, ɗan Sama’ila,

title: 1 Tarihi 6:34
content: 34 ɗan Elkana, ɗan Yeroham, ɗan Eliyel, ɗan Towa,

title: 1 Tarihi 6:35
content: 35 ɗan Zuf, ɗan Elkana, ɗan Mahat, ɗan Amasai,

title: 1 Tarihi 6:36
content: 36 ɗan Elkana, ɗan Yowel, ɗan Azariya, ɗan Zefaniya

title: 1 Tarihi 6:37
content: 37 ɗan Tahat, ɗan Assir, ɗan Ebiyasaf, ɗan Kora,

title: 1 Tarihi 6:38
content: 38 ɗan Izhar, ɗan Kohat, ɗan Lawi, ɗan Isra’ila;

title: 1 Tarihi 6:39
content: 39 da kuma Asaf ’yan’uwan Heman, waɗanda suka yi hidima a hannun damansa. Asaf ɗan Berekiya, ɗan Shimeya,

title: 1 Tarihi 6:40
content: 40 ɗan Mika’ilu, ɗan Ba’asehiya, ɗan Malkiya,

title: 1 Tarihi 6:41
content: 41 ɗan Etni, ɗan Zera, ɗan Adahiya

title: 1 Tarihi 6:42
content: 42 ɗan Etan, ɗan Zimma, ɗan Shimeyi,

title: 1 Tarihi 6:43
content: 43 ɗan Yahat, ɗan Gershom, ɗan Lawi;

title: 1 Tarihi 6:44
content: 44 da kuma daga ’yan’uwansu, mutanen Merari, a hannun hagunsa. Etan ɗan Kishi, ɗan Abdi, ɗan Malluk,

title: 1 Tarihi 6:45
content: 45 ɗan Hashabiya, ɗan Amaziya, ɗan Hilkiya,

title: 1 Tarihi 6:46
content: 46 ɗan Amzi, ɗan Bani, ɗan Shemer,

title: 1 Tarihi 6:47
content: 47 ɗan Mali, ɗan Mushi, ɗan Merari, ɗan Lawi.

title: 1 Tarihi 6:48
content: 48 Aka ba ’yan’uwansu Lawiyawa dukan sauran ayyukan tabanakul, gidan Allah.

title: 1 Tarihi 6:49
content: 49 Amma Haruna da zuriyarsa su ne waɗanda suke miƙa hadayu a kan bagaden hadaya ta ƙonawa da kuma a kan bagaden turare haɗe da dukan abin da ake yi a Wuri Mafi Tsarki, suna yin kafara domin Isra’ila, bisa ga dukan abin da Musa bawan Allah ya umarta.

title: 1 Tarihi 6:50
content: 50 Waɗannan su ne zuriyar Haruna, Eleyazar, Finehas, Abishuwa,

title: 1 Tarihi 6:51
content: 51 Bukki, Uzzi, Zerahiya,

title: 1 Tarihi 6:52
content: 52 Merahiyot, Amariya, Ahitub,

title: 1 Tarihi 6:53
content: 53 Zadok da Ahimawaz.

title: 1 Tarihi 6:54
content: 54 Waɗannan su ne wuraren zamansu da aka ba su rabo su zama yankunansu (aka ba wa zuriyar Haruna waɗanda suke daga gidan Kohat, domin rabo na fari nasu ne):

title: 1 Tarihi 6:55
content: 55 Aka ba su Hebron a Yahuda tare da wuraren kiwon da suke kewayenta.

title: 1 Tarihi 6:56
content: 56 Amma filaye da ƙauyukan da suke kewayen birnin aka ba wa Kaleb ɗan Yefunne.

title: 1 Tarihi 6:57
content: 57 Saboda haka aka ba wa zuriyar Haruna Hebron (birnin mafaka), da Libna, Yattir Eshtemowa,

title: 1 Tarihi 6:58
content: 58 Hilen, Debir,

title: 1 Tarihi 6:59
content: 59 Ashan, Yutta da Bet-Shemesh, tare da wuraren kiwonsu.

title: 1 Tarihi 6:60
content: 60 Daga kabilar Benyamin kuma aka ba su Gibeyon, Geba, Alemet da Anatot, tare da wuraren kiwonsu. Waɗannan garuruwa waɗanda aka raba a tsakanin mutanen gidan Kohat, goma sha uku ne duka.

title: 1 Tarihi 6:61
content: 61 Aka ba sauran zuriyar Kohat rabon garuruwa goma daga gidajen rabin kabilar Manasse.

title: 1 Tarihi 6:62
content: 62 Aka ba zuriyar Gershom, gida-gida, rabon garuruwa goma sha uku daga kabilan Issakar, Asher da Naftali, da kuma daga sashen rabi kabilar Manasse da yake a Bashan.

title: 1 Tarihi 6:63
content: 63 Aka ba zuriyar Merari, gida-gida, rabon garuruwa goma sha biyu daga kabilan Ruben, Gad da Zebulun.

title: 1 Tarihi 6:64
content: 64 Saboda haka Isra’ilawa suka ba Lawiyawa waɗannan garuruwa da wuraren kiwonsu.

title: 1 Tarihi 6:65
content: 65 Daga kabilan Yahuda, Simeyon da Benyamin suka ba su rabon sunayen garuruwan da aka ambata.

title: 1 Tarihi 6:66
content: 66 Aka ba wa waɗansu na mutanen gidan Kohat yankin garuruwansu daga kabilar Efraim.

title: 1 Tarihi 6:67
content: 67 A ƙasar tudun Efraim aka ba su Shekem (birnin mafaka), da Gezer,

title: 1 Tarihi 6:68
content: 68 Yokmeyam, Bet-Horon,

title: 1 Tarihi 6:69
content: 69 Aiyalon da Gat-Rimmon, tare da wuraren kiwonsu.

title: 1 Tarihi 6:70
content: 70 Daga rabin kabilar Manasse kuwa, Isra’ilawa suka ba da Aner da Bileyam, tare da wuraren kiwonsu, ga sauran gidajen mutanen Kohat.

title: 1 Tarihi 6:71
content: 71 Mutanen Gershom suka sami waɗannan. Daga gidan rabin kabilar Manasse, sun sami Golan a Bashan da kuma Ashtarot, tare da wuraren kiwonsu;

title: 1 Tarihi 6:72
content: 72 daga kabilar Issakar suka sami Kedesh, Daberat,

title: 1 Tarihi 6:73
content: 73 Ramot da Anem, tare da wuraren kiwonsu;

title: 1 Tarihi 6:74
content: 74 daga kabilar Asher suka sami Mashal, Abdon,

title: 1 Tarihi 6:75
content: 75 Hukok da Rehob, tare da wuraren kiwonsu;

title: 1 Tarihi 6:76
content: 76 daga kabilar Naftali kuwa suka sami Kedesh a Galili, Hammon da Kiriyatayim, tare da wuraren kiwonsu.

title: 1 Tarihi 6:77
content: 77 Mutanen Merari (sauran Lawiyawan) suka sami waɗannan. Daga kabilar Zebulun suka sami Yokneyam, Karta, Rimmon da Tabor, tare da wuraren kiwonsu;

title: 1 Tarihi 6:78
content: 78 daga kabilar Ruben a hayin Urdun a gabashi Yeriko suka sami Bezer a hamada, Yahza,

title: 1 Tarihi 6:79
content: 79 Kedemot da Mefa’at, tare da wuraren kiwonsu;

title: 1 Tarihi 6:80
content: 80 daga kabilar Gad kuwa suka sami Ramot a Gileyad, Mahanayim,

title: 1 Tarihi 6:81
content: 81 Heshbon da Yazer, tare da wuraren kiwonsu.

title: 1 Tarihi 7:1
content: 1 ’Ya’yan Issakar maza su ne, Tola, Fuwa, Yashub da Shimron, su huɗu ne duka.

title: 1 Tarihi 7:2
content: 2 ’Ya’yan Tola maza su ne, Uzzi, Refahiya, Yeriyel, Ibsam da Sama’ila, su ne kuma kawunan iyalansu. A zamanin mulkin Dawuda, an rubuta zuriyar Tola a matsayin mayaƙa a cikin tarihinsu, sun kai 22,600.

title: 1 Tarihi 7:3
content: 3 Ɗan Uzzi shi ne, Izrahiya. ’Ya’yan Izrahiya maza su ne, Mika’ilu, Obadiya, Yowel da Isshiya. Dukansu biyar manya ne.

title: 1 Tarihi 7:4
content: 4 Bisa ga tarihin iyalinsu, sun kai mutane 36,000 shiryayyu don yaƙi, gama suna da mata da ’ya’ya da yawa.

title: 1 Tarihi 7:5
content: 5 Dangin da suke maza masu yaƙi sun kasance na dukan gidajen Issakar ne, kamar yadda aka rubuta a cikin tarihi, su 87,000 ne duka.

title: 1 Tarihi 7:6
content: 6 ’Ya’ya uku maza na Benyamin su ne, Bela, Beker da Yediyayel.

title: 1 Tarihi 7:7
content: 7 ’Ya’yan Bela maza su ne, Ezbon, Uzzi, Uzziyel, Yerimot da Iri, su ne kawunan iyalai, kuma su biyar ne duka. Rubutaccen tarihin zuriyarsu ya nuna suna mazan da sun isa yaƙi 22,034.

title: 1 Tarihi 7:8
content: 8 ’Ya’yan Beker maza su ne, Zemira, Yowash, Eliyezer, Eliyohenai, Omri, Yeremot, Abiya, Anatot da Alemet. Dukan waɗannan ’ya’yan Beker maza ne.

title: 1 Tarihi 7:9
content: 9 Rubutaccen tarihin zuriyarsu ya nuna suna da kawunan iyalai da mazan da suka isa yaƙi 20,200.

title: 1 Tarihi 7:10
content: 10 Ɗan Yediyayel shi ne, Bilhan. ’Ya’yan Bilhan maza su ne, Yewush, Benyamin, Ehud, Kena’ana, Zetan, Tarshish da Ahishahar.

title: 1 Tarihi 7:11
content: 11 Dukan waɗannan ’ya’yan Yediyayel maza kawunan iyalai ne. Akwai mazan da suka isa yaƙi waje 17,200.

title: 1 Tarihi 7:12
content: 12 Shuffiyawa da Huffiyawa zuriyar Ir ne, kuma Hushiyawa zuriyar Aher ne.

title: 1 Tarihi 7:13
content: 13 ’Ya’yan Naftali maza su ne, Yaziyel, Guni, Yezer da Shallum, su zuriyar Bilha ne.

title: 1 Tarihi 7:14
content: 14 Zuriyar Manasse su ne, Asriyel zuriyarsa ne ta wurin ƙwarƙwararsa mutuniyar Aram. Ta haifa wa Makir mahaifin Gileyad.

title: 1 Tarihi 7:15
content: 15 Makir ya auri mata daga cikin Huffiyawa da Shuffiyawa. ’Yar’uwarsa ita ce Ma’aka. Wani daga zuriyar, sunansa Zelofehad, shi yana da ’ya’yan mata ne kawai.

title: 1 Tarihi 7:16
content: 16 Ma’aka matar Makir ta haifi ɗa ta kuma ba shi suna Feresh. Sunan ɗan’uwansa Sheresh, ’ya’yan Feresh maza kuwa su ne Ulam da Rakem.

title: 1 Tarihi 7:17
content: 17 Ɗan Ulam shi ne, Bedan. Duka waɗannan zuriyar Gileyad ne. Gileyad ɗan Makir ne, Makir kuma ɗan Manasse.

title: 1 Tarihi 7:18
content: 18 ’Yar’uwarsa Makir mai suna Hammoleket ta haifi Ishod, Abiyezer da Mala.

title: 1 Tarihi 7:19
content: 19 ’Ya’yan Shemida maza su ne, Ahiyan, Shekem, Liki da Aniyam.

title: 1 Tarihi 7:20
content: 20 Zuriyar Efraim su ne, Shutela, Bered, Tahat, Eleyada, Tahat

title: 1 Tarihi 7:21
content: 21 Zabad da Shutela. Wani ɗan ƙasa haifaffen mutanen Gat ya kashe Ezer da Elad, sa’ad da suka gangara don su ƙwace dabbobinsu.

title: 1 Tarihi 7:22
content: 22 Mahaifinsu Efraim ya yi makoki dominsu kwanaki masu yawa sai danginsa suka zo don su yi masa ta’aziyya.

title: 1 Tarihi 7:23
content: 23 Sa’an nan ya sāke kwana da matarsa, sai ta yi ciki ta haifi ɗa. Ya ba shi suna Beriya, saboda masifar da ta auko a cikin iyalinsa.

title: 1 Tarihi 7:24
content: 24 ’Yarsa ita ce Sheyera, wadda ta gina Bet-Horon na kwari da na tudu da kuma Uzzen-Sheyera. Zuriyarsa ita ce,

title: 1 Tarihi 7:25
content: 25 Refa, Reshef, Tela, Tahan,

title: 1 Tarihi 7:26
content: 26 Ladan, Ammihud, Elishama,

title: 1 Tarihi 7:27
content: 27 Nun da kuma Yoshuwa.

title: 1 Tarihi 7:28
content: 28 Ƙasarsu da wuraren zamansu sun haɗa da Betel da ƙauyukan kewayenta, Na’aran wajen gabas, Gezer da ƙauyukanta wajen yamma, da kuma Shekem da ƙauyukan da suka nausa har zuwa Aiya da ƙauyukanta.

title: 1 Tarihi 7:29
content: 29 A iyakokin Manasse akwai Bet-Sheyan, Ta’anak, Megiddo da Dor, tare da ƙauyukansu. Zuriyar Yusuf ɗan Isra’ila ta zauna a waɗannan garuruwa.

title: 1 Tarihi 7:30
content: 30 ’Ya’yan Asher maza su ne, Imna, Ishba, Ishwi da Beriya. ’Yar’uwarsa ita ce Sera.

title: 1 Tarihi 7:31
content: 31 ’Ya’yan Beriya maza su ne, Heber da Malkiyel, wanda yake mahaifin Birzayit.

title: 1 Tarihi 7:32
content: 32 Heber shi ne mahaifin Yaflet, Shomer da Hotam da kuma ’yar’uwarsu Shuwa.

title: 1 Tarihi 7:33
content: 33 ’Ya’yan Yaflet maza su ne, Fasak, Bimhal da Ashwat. Waɗannan su ne ’ya’yan Yaflet maza.

title: 1 Tarihi 7:34
content: 34 ’Ya’yan Shemer maza su ne, Ahi, Roga, Yehubba da Aram.

title: 1 Tarihi 7:35
content: 35 ’Ya’yan ɗan’uwansa Helem su ne, Zofa, Imna, Shelesh da Amal.

title: 1 Tarihi 7:36
content: 36 ’Ya’yan Zofa maza su ne, Suwa, Harnefer, Shuwal, Beri, Imra,

title: 1 Tarihi 7:37
content: 37 Bezer, Hod, Shamma, Shilsha, Itran da Bera.

title: 1 Tarihi 7:38
content: 38 ’Ya’yan Yeter maza su ne, Yefunne, Fisfa da Ara.

title: 1 Tarihi 7:39
content: 39 ’Ya’yan Ulla maza su ne, Ara, Hanniyel da Riziya.

title: 1 Tarihi 7:40
content: 40 Dukan waɗannan zuriyar Asher ne, kawunan iyalai, zaɓaɓɓun mutane, jarumawa sosai da kuma fitattun shugabanni. Yawan mutanen da suke a shirye don yaƙi, kamar yadda aka lissafta zuriyarsu, 26,000 ne.

title: 1 Tarihi 8:1
content: 1 Benyamin shi ne mahaifin, Bela ɗansa na fari, Ashbel ɗansa na biyu, Ahara na uku,

title: 1 Tarihi 8:2
content: 2 Noha na huɗu da Rafa na biyar.

title: 1 Tarihi 8:3
content: 3 ’Ya’yan Bela maza su ne, Addar, Gera, Abihud

title: 1 Tarihi 8:4
content: 4 Abishuwa, Na’aman, Ahowa,

title: 1 Tarihi 8:5
content: 5 Gera, Shefufan da Huram.

title: 1 Tarihi 8:6
content: 6 Waɗannan su ne zuriyar Ehud, waɗanda suke kawunan iyalan waɗanda suke zama a Geba waɗanda aka kuma kwasa zuwa Manahat.

title: 1 Tarihi 8:7
content: 7 Na’aman, da Ahiya, da Gera. Gera ne shugabansu lokacin da aka kai su bauta, shi ne ya haifi Uzza da Ahilud.

title: 1 Tarihi 8:8
content: 8 An haifa ’ya’ya maza wa Shaharayim a Mowab bayan ya saki matansa Hushim da Ba’ara.

title: 1 Tarihi 8:9
content: 9 Ya haifi Yobab, Zibiya, Hodesh, Malkam,

title: 1 Tarihi 8:10
content: 10 Yewuz, Sakiya da Mirma ta wurin Hodesh matarsa. Waɗannan su ne ’ya’yansa, kawunan iyalai.

title: 1 Tarihi 8:11
content: 11 Ya haifi Abitub da Efa’al ta wurin Hushim.

title: 1 Tarihi 8:12
content: 12 ’Ya’yan Efa’al maza su ne, Eber, Misham, Shemed (wanda ya gina Ono da Lod tare da ƙauyukan kewayensu),

title: 1 Tarihi 8:13
content: 13 da Beriya da Shema, waɗanda suke kawunan iyalan waɗanda suke zama a Aiyalon waɗanda kuma suka kori mazaunan Gat.

title: 1 Tarihi 8:14
content: 14 Ahiyo, Shashak, Yeremot

title: 1 Tarihi 8:15
content: 15 Zebadiya, Arad, Eder,

title: 1 Tarihi 8:16
content: 16 Mika’ilu, Isfa da Yoha su ne ’ya’yan Beriya maza.

title: 1 Tarihi 8:17
content: 17 Zebadiya, Meshullam, Hizki, Heber,

title: 1 Tarihi 8:18
content: 18 Ishmerai, Izliya da Yobab su ne ’ya’yan Efa’al maza.

title: 1 Tarihi 8:19
content: 19 Yakim, Zikri, Zabdi,

title: 1 Tarihi 8:20
content: 20 Eliyenai, Zilletai, Eliyel,

title: 1 Tarihi 8:21
content: 21 Adahiya, Berahiya da Shimra su ne ’ya’yan Shimeyi maza.

title: 1 Tarihi 8:22
content: 22 Ishfan, Eber, Eliyel,

title: 1 Tarihi 8:23
content: 23 Abdon, Zikri, Hanan,

title: 1 Tarihi 8:24
content: 24 Hananiya, Elam, Antotiya,

title: 1 Tarihi 8:25
content: 25 Ifdehiya da Fenuwel su ne ’ya’yan Shashak maza.

title: 1 Tarihi 8:26
content: 26 Shamsherai, Shehariya, Ataliya,

title: 1 Tarihi 8:27
content: 27 Ya’areshiya, Iliya da Zikri su ne ’ya’yan Yeroham maza.

title: 1 Tarihi 8:28
content: 28 Dukan waɗannan su ne kawunan iyalai, manya kamar yadda aka lissafta a cikin zuriyarsu, suka zauna a Urushalima.

title: 1 Tarihi 8:29
content: 29 Yehiyel na Gibeyon ya zauna a Gibeyon. Sunan matarsa Ma’aka,

title: 1 Tarihi 8:30
content: 30 ɗansa na fari kuwa shi ne Abdon, sai Zur, Kish, Ba’al, Ner, Nadab,

title: 1 Tarihi 8:31
content: 31 Gedor, Ahiyo, Zeker

title: 1 Tarihi 8:32
content: 32 da Miklot, wanda ya zama mahaifin Shimeya. Su ma sun zauna kusa da danginsu a Urushalima.

title: 1 Tarihi 8:33
content: 33 Ner shi ne mahaifin Kish, Kish mahaifin Shawulu, kuma Shawulu ne mahaifin Yonatan, Malki-Shuwa, Abinadab da Esh-Ba’al.

title: 1 Tarihi 8:34
content: 34 Ɗan Yonatan shi ne, Merib-Ba’al wanda ya zama mahaifin Mika.

title: 1 Tarihi 8:35
content: 35 ’Ya’yan Mika maza su ne, Fiton, Melek, Tereya da Ahaz.

title: 1 Tarihi 8:36
content: 36 Ahaz shi ne mahaifin Yehowadda, Yehowadda shi ne mahaifin Alemet, Azmawet da Zimri, Zimri kuwa shi ne mahaifin Moza.

title: 1 Tarihi 8:37
content: 37 Moza shi ne mahaifin Bineya; Rafa, Eleyasa da kuma Azel.

title: 1 Tarihi 8:38
content: 38 Azel yana da ’ya’ya maza shida, kuma ga sunayensu. Azrikam, Bokeru, Ishmayel, Sheyariya, Obadiya da Hanan. Dukan waɗannan ’ya’yan Azel maza ne.

title: 1 Tarihi 8:39
content: 39 ’Ya’yan ɗan’uwansa Eshek su ne, Ulam ɗan farinsa, Yewush ɗansa na biyu da Elifelet na uku.

title: 1 Tarihi 8:40
content: 40 ’Ya’yan Ulam maza jarumawa ne sosai waɗanda suke iya riƙe baka. Suna da ’ya’ya maza masu yawa da jikoki, 150 gaba ɗaya. Dukan waɗannan zuriyar Benyamin ne.

title: 1 Tarihi 9:1
content: 1 Haka aka lissafta dukan Isra’ila a tarihin zuriyoyi a littafin sarakunan Isra’ila. Aka kwasa mutanen Yahuda zuwa zaman bauta a Babilon domin rashin aminci.

title: 1 Tarihi 9:2
content: 2 To, na farkon da aka sāke zaunar da su a mallakarsu a garuruwansu, su ne waɗansu Isra’ilawa, firistoci, Lawiyawa da kuma masu hidimar haikali.

title: 1 Tarihi 9:3
content: 3 Waɗanda suke daga Yahuda, daga Benyamin, da kuma daga Efraim da Manasse waɗanda suka zauna a Urushalima su ne,

title: 1 Tarihi 9:4
content: 4 Uttai ɗan Ammihud, ɗan Omri, ɗan Imri, ɗan Bani, zuriyar Ferez ɗan Yahuda.

title: 1 Tarihi 9:5
content: 5 Na mutanen Shilo kuwa su ne, Asahiya ɗan fari da ’ya’yansa maza.

title: 1 Tarihi 9:6
content: 6 Na mutanen Zera su ne, Yewuyel. Mutane daga Yahuda sun kai 690.

title: 1 Tarihi 9:7
content: 7 Na Benyamin su ne, Sallu ɗan Meshullam, ɗan Hodawiya, ɗan Hassenuwa;

title: 1 Tarihi 9:8
content: 8 Ibnehiya ɗan Yeroham; Ela ɗan Uzzi, ɗan Mikri; da Meshullam ɗan Shefatiya, ɗan Reyuwel, ɗan Ibniya.

title: 1 Tarihi 9:9
content: 9 Mutane daga Benyamin, kamar yadda aka lissafta zuriyarsu, sun kai 956. Dukan waɗannan mutane kawunan iyalansu ne.

title: 1 Tarihi 9:10
content: 10 Na firistoci su ne, Yedahiya; Yehoyarib; Yakin;

title: 1 Tarihi 9:11
content: 11 Azariya ɗan Hilkiya, ɗan Meshullam, ɗan Zadok, ɗan Merahiyot, ɗan Ahitub, shugaban da yake lura da gidan Allah;

title: 1 Tarihi 9:12
content: 12 Adahiya ɗan Yeroham, ɗan Fashhur, ɗan Malkiya; da Ma’asai ɗan Adiyel, ɗan Yazera, ɗan Meshullam, ɗan Meshillemit, ɗan Immer.

title: 1 Tarihi 9:13
content: 13 Firistocin da suke kawunan iyalai, sun kai 1,760. Dukansu ƙwararru ne, masu hakkin hidima a cikin gidan Allah.

title: 1 Tarihi 9:14
content: 14 Na Lawiyawa su ne, Shemahiya ɗan Hasshub, ɗan Azrikam, ɗan Hashabiya, mutumin Merari;

title: 1 Tarihi 9:15
content: 15 Bakbakkar, Heresh, Galal da Mattaniya ɗan Mika, ɗan Zikri, ɗan Asaf;

title: 1 Tarihi 9:16
content: 16 Obadiya ɗan Shemahiya, ɗan Galal, ɗan Yedutun; da Berekiya ɗan Asa, ɗan Elkana, wanda ya zauna a ƙauyukan Netofawa.

title: 1 Tarihi 9:17
content: 17 Matsaran ƙofofi su ne, Shallum, Akkub, Talmon, Ahiman da ’yan’uwansu. Shallum ne babbansu

title: 1 Tarihi 9:18
content: 18 da aka ajiye a Ƙofar Sarki a gabas, har zuwa wannan lokaci. Waɗannan su ne matsaran ƙofofi na sansanin Lawiyawa.

title: 1 Tarihi 9:19
content: 19 Shallum ɗan Kore, ɗan Ebiyasaf, ɗan Kora, da ’yan’uwansa matsaran ƙofofi daga iyalin (mutanen Kohat) su suke da hakkin tsaron madogaran ƙofar Tenti kamar dai yadda kakanninsu suka kasance da hakkin tsaron mashigin mazaunin Ubangiji.

title: 1 Tarihi 9:20
content: 20 A dā Finehas ɗan Eleyazar ne yake lura da matsaran, kuma Ubangiji ya kasance tare da shi.

title: 1 Tarihi 9:21
content: 21 Zakariya ɗan Meshelemiya shi ne mai tsaro a mashigin Tentin Sujada.

title: 1 Tarihi 9:22
content: 22 Duka-duka, waɗanda aka zaɓa don su zama matsaran madogaran ƙofa sun kai 212. Aka rubuta su zuriya-zuriya a ƙauyukansu. Dawuda da Sama’ila mai duba ne suka sa matsaran a wurarensu na aminci.

title: 1 Tarihi 9:23
content: 23 Su da zuriyarsu, su suke lura da tsaron ƙofofin gidan Ubangiji, gidan da ake kira Tenti.

title: 1 Tarihi 9:24
content: 24 Matsaran suna a kusurwoyi huɗu, gabas, yamma, arewa da kudu.

title: 1 Tarihi 9:25
content: 25 ’Yan’uwansu a ƙauyukansu sukan zo lokaci, lokaci su yi ayyukansu kwana bakwai, bakwai.

title: 1 Tarihi 9:26
content: 26 Amma manyan matsara huɗu, waɗanda suke Lawiyawa, an danƙa musu hakkin lura da ɗakuna da kuma wuraren ajiya a gidan Allah.

title: 1 Tarihi 9:27
content: 27 Sukan kwana a kewayen gidan Allah, domin dole su tsare shi; kuma su suke lura da mabuɗi don buɗewa a kowace safiya.

title: 1 Tarihi 9:28
content: 28 Waɗansunsu su ne suke lura da kayayyakin da ake amfani da su a hidimar haikali; sukan ƙirga su sa’ad da ake shigar da su da sa’ad da ake fitar da su.

title: 1 Tarihi 9:29
content: 29 An sa waɗansu su lura da kayayyakin da kuma dukan waɗansu kayan wuri mai tsarki, da kuma gari da ruwan inabi, da mai, turare da kuma kayan yaji.

title: 1 Tarihi 9:30
content: 30 Amma waɗansu firistoci ne suke harhaɗa kayan yajin.

title: 1 Tarihi 9:31
content: 31 Wani Balawe mai suna Mattitiya, ɗan farin Shallum mutumin Kora ne aka danƙa masa hakkin toya burodin miƙawa.

title: 1 Tarihi 9:32
content: 32 Waɗansu ’yan’uwansu Kohatawa ne suke lura da shiryawa burodin da ake kaiwa a tebur a kowane Asabbaci.

title: 1 Tarihi 9:33
content: 33 Waɗanda suke mawaƙa, kawunan iyalan Lawiyawa, sukan zauna a ɗakunan haikali kuma ba sa yin waɗansu ayyuka domin su suke da hakkin aiki dare da rana.

title: 1 Tarihi 9:34
content: 34 Dukan waɗannan su ne kawunan iyalan Lawiyawa, manya kamar yadda aka lissafta su a zuriyarsu, kuma suna zama a Urushalima.

title: 1 Tarihi 9:35
content: 35 Yehiyel mahaifin Gibeyon ya zauna a Gibeyon. Matarsa ita ce Ma’aka

title: 1 Tarihi 9:36
content: 36 ɗansa na fari kuwa shi ne Abdon, sai Zur, Kish, Ba’al, Ner, Nadab,

title: 1 Tarihi 9:37
content: 37 Gedor, Ahiyo, Zakariya da Miklot.

title: 1 Tarihi 9:38
content: 38 Miklot shi ne mahaifin Shimeyam. Su ma sun zauna kusa da danginsu a Urushalima.

title: 1 Tarihi 9:39
content: 39 Ner shi mahaifin Kish, Kish mahaifin Shawulu, kuma Shawulu shi ne mahaifin Yonatan, Malki-Shuwa, Abinadab da Esh-Ba’al.

title: 1 Tarihi 9:40
content: 40 Ɗan Yonatan shi ne, Merib-Ba’al wanda shi ne mahaifin Mika.

title: 1 Tarihi 9:41
content: 41 ’Ya’yan Mika maza su ne, Fiton, Melek, Tareya da Ahaz.

title: 1 Tarihi 9:42
content: 42 Ahaz shi ne mahaifin Yada, Yada shi ne mahaifin Alemet, Azmawet da Zimri, Zimri kuwa shi ne mahaifin Moza.

title: 1 Tarihi 9:43
content: 43 Moza shi ne mahaifin Bineya; Refahiya, Eleyasa da kuma Azel.

title: 1 Tarihi 9:44
content: 44 Azel yana da ’ya’ya maza shida, kuma ga sunayensu. Azrikam, Bokeru, Ishmayel, Sheyariya, Obadiya da Hanan. Waɗannan su ne ’ya’yan Azel maza.

title: 1 Tarihi 10:1
content: 1 To, fa, Filistiyawa suka yi yaƙi da Isra’ilawa; Isra’ilawa kuwa suka gudu a gabansu, da yawa kuma suka mutu a kan Dutsen Gilbowa.

title: 1 Tarihi 10:2
content: 2 Filistiyawa suka matsa sosai suna bin Shawulu da ’ya’yansa maza, suka kuma kashe ’ya’yansa maza Yonatan, Abinadab da Malki-Shuwa.

title: 1 Tarihi 10:3
content: 3 Yaƙin ya yi tsanani kewaye da Shawulu, kuma sa’ad da maharba suka rutsa shi, sai suka ji masa rauni.

title: 1 Tarihi 10:4
content: 4 Sai Shawulu ya ce wa mai riƙe masa kayan yaƙi, “Zare takobinka ka soke ni, in ba haka ba waɗannan marasa kaciya za su zo su yi mini ba’a.” Amma mai ɗaukar masa kayan yaƙi ya ji tsoro bai kuwa yi haka ba; saboda haka Shawulu ya zāre takobinsa ya fāɗi a kansa.

title: 1 Tarihi 10:5
content: 5 Da mai ɗaukar masa kayan yaƙi ya ga Shawulu ya mutu, sai shi ma ya fāɗi a kan takobinsa ya mutu.

title: 1 Tarihi 10:6
content: 6 Ta haka Shawulu da ’ya’yansa maza uku suka mutu, dukan gidansa kuwa suka mutu tare.

title: 1 Tarihi 10:7
content: 7 Sa’ad da dukan Isra’ilawa a cikin kwari suka ga cewa mayaƙansu suna gudu, kuma cewa Shawulu da ’ya’yansa maza sun mutu, sai suka bar garuruwansu suka gudu. Filistiyawa kuwa suka zo suka zauna a cikinsu.

title: 1 Tarihi 10:8
content: 8 Kashegari, da Filistiyawa suka zo don su tuttuɓe waɗanda suka mutu, sai suka sami Shawulu da ’ya’yansa maza sun mutu a Dutsen Gilbowa.

title: 1 Tarihi 10:9
content: 9 Suka tuttuɓe shi suka yanke kansa suka ɗauka duk da kayan yaƙinsa, suka kuma aika ’yan aika ko’ina a ƙasar Filistiyawa, a yi shela labarin a cikin gumakansu da kuma mutanensu.

title: 1 Tarihi 10:10
content: 10 Suka sa kayan yaƙinsa a haikalin allahnsu suka kuma rataye kansa a haikalin Dagon.

title: 1 Tarihi 10:11
content: 11 Sa’ad da mazaunan Yabesh Gileyad suka ji dukan abin da Filistiyawa suka yi wa Shawulu,

title: 1 Tarihi 10:12
content: 12 sai dukan jarumawa suka tafi suka ɗauki jikunan Shawulu da na ’ya’yansa maza suka kawo Yabesh. Sa’an nan suka binne ƙasusuwan a ƙarƙashin babban itace oak a Yabesh, suka kuma yi azumi kwana bakwai.

title: 1 Tarihi 10:13
content: 13 Shawulu ya mutu domin rashin aminci ga Ubangiji; bai kiyaye maganar Ubangiji ba, ya ma nemi shawarar mace mai duba,

title: 1 Tarihi 10:14
content: 14 bai kuwa nemi nufin Ubangiji ba. Saboda haka Ubangiji ya kashe shi, ya miƙa mulkin ga Dawuda ɗan Yesse.

title: 1 Tarihi 11:1
content: 1 Dukan Isra’ila fa suka taru wurin Dawuda a Hebron suka ce, “Mu jiki da jininka ne.

title: 1 Tarihi 11:2
content: 2 A dā, ko a lokacin da Shawulu yake sarki, ai, kai ne kake shugabantar Isra’ila a yaƙe-yaƙe. Kuma Ubangiji Allahnka ya ce maka, ‘Za ka zama makiyayin mutanena Isra’ila, za ka kuma zama mai mulkinsu.’ ”

title: 1 Tarihi 11:3
content: 3 Sa’ad da dukan dattawan Isra’ila suka zo wurin Sarki Dawuda a Hebron, suka yi yarjejjeniya da shi a gaban Ubangiji, suka kuwa shafe Dawuda ya zama sarki a bisa Isra’ila, yadda Ubangiji ya yi alkawari ta wurin Sama’ila.

title: 1 Tarihi 11:4
content: 4 Dawuda tare da dukan Isra’ilawa suka taka zuwa Urushalima (wato, Yebus). Yebusiyawan da suke zama a wurin

title: 1 Tarihi 11:5
content: 5 suka ce wa Dawuda, “Ba za ka shiga nan ba.” Duk da haka, Dawuda ya ci kagarar Sihiyona, Birnin Dawuda.

title: 1 Tarihi 11:6
content: 6 Dawuda ya ce, “Duk wanda ya jagoranci yaƙi a kan Yebusiyawa zai zama babban shugaban mayaƙa.” Yowab ɗan Zeruhiya ya fara haurawa, ta haka ya zama shugaba.

title: 1 Tarihi 11:7
content: 7 Dawuda zauna a kagarar, ta haka aka kira ta Birnin Dawuda.

title: 1 Tarihi 11:8
content: 8 Sai ya gina birni kewaye da shi, daga madogaran gini zuwa katangar da take kewaye, yayinda Yowab ya maido da sauran birnin.

title: 1 Tarihi 11:9
content: 9 Dawuda kuwa ya ƙara ƙarfi, domin Ubangiji Maɗaukaki yana tare da shi.

title: 1 Tarihi 11:10
content: 10 Waɗannan su ne manyan jarumawan Dawuda, su ne, tare da dukan Isra’ila, suka ba wa mulkinsa goyon baya mai ƙarfi da ya kai bisa dukan ƙasar, yadda Ubangiji ya yi alkawari.

title: 1 Tarihi 11:11
content: 11 Ga jerin sunayen jarumawan Dawuda. Yashobeyam wani ɗan Hakmoni, shi ne babban shugaba; ya ɗaga māshinsa a kan mutum ɗari uku, waɗanda ya kashe a ƙarawa guda kawai.

title: 1 Tarihi 11:12
content: 12 Biye da shi, shi ne Eleyazar ɗan Dodo mutumin Aho, ɗaya daga cikin jarumawa uku.

title: 1 Tarihi 11:13
content: 13 Yana tare da Dawuda a Fas Dammim sa’ad da Filistiyawa suka taru can don yaƙi. A wani wuri inda akwai gona cike da sha’ir, sojoji suka gudu daga Filistiyawa.

title: 1 Tarihi 11:14
content: 14 Sai shi da Dawuda suka shiga gonar sha’ir ɗin, suka tsaya ciki don su tsare ta. Suka ragargaza Filistiyawa, Ubangiji kuma ya kawo babban nasara.

title: 1 Tarihi 11:15
content: 15 Wata rana uku cikin manyan mutanen nan talatin suka gangara wurin Dawuda zuwa dutse a kogon Adullam, yayinda ƙungiyar Filistiyawa suke sansani a Kwarin Refayim.

title: 1 Tarihi 11:16
content: 16 A lokacin Dawuda yana cikin mafaka, sojojin Filistiyawa kuma suna a Betlehem.

title: 1 Tarihi 11:17
content: 17 Dawuda ya ji marmarin ruwan sha sai ya ce, “Kash, a ce wani zai sami mini ruwan sha daga rijiya kusa da ƙofar Betlehem mana!”

title: 1 Tarihi 11:18
content: 18 Sai Ukun suka kutsa kai cikin sansanin Filistiyawa, suka ja ruwa daga rijiyar da take kusa da ƙofar Betlehem suka ɗauko shi suka kawo wa Dawuda. Amma ya ƙi yă sha; a maimako, sai ya zubar da shi a gaban Ubangiji.

title: 1 Tarihi 11:19
content: 19 Ya ce, “Allah yă sawwaƙe in yi haka, ya kamata in sha jinin waɗannan mutanen da suka yi kasai da rayukansu?” Domin sun yi kasai da rayukansu don su dawo da shi, Dawuda bai sha shi ba. Irin abubuwan da jarumawa ukun nan suka yi ke nan.

title: 1 Tarihi 11:20
content: 20 Abishai ɗan’uwan Yowab shi ma babba ne cikin Ukun nan. Ya ɗaga māshinsa a kan mutum ɗari uku, waɗanda ya kashe, ya kuma zama sananne kamar Ukun.

title: 1 Tarihi 11:21
content: 21 Aka ninka girmama shi bisa Ukun, sai ya zama shugaba, ko da yake ba a haɗa shi a cikinsu ba.

title: 1 Tarihi 11:22
content: 22 Benahiya ɗan Yehohiyada shi ma wani barden yaƙi ne daga Kabzeyel, wanda ya yi manyan abubuwa. Ya bugi gwanayen Mowab biyu. Ya kuma gangara zuwa cikin rami a ranar da aka yi dusar ƙanƙara ya kashe zaki.

title: 1 Tarihi 11:23
content: 23 Ya kuma kashe wani mutumin Masar mai tsayi ƙafa bakwai da rabi. Ko da yake mutumin Masar yana da māshi kamar sandan masaƙa a hannunsa, Benahiya ya yaƙe shi da kulki. Ya ƙwace māshin daga hannun mutumin Masar ya kuma kashe shi da māshin nan nasa.

title: 1 Tarihi 11:24
content: 24 Irin abubuwan da Benahiya ɗan Yehohiyada ya yi ke nan; shi ma sananne ne kamar waɗannan jarumawa uku.

title: 1 Tarihi 11:25
content: 25 Aka ɗauka shi da bangirma fiye da Talatin nan, amma ba a haɗa shi cikin Ukun ba. Dawuda kuwa ya sa shi yă lura da masu tsaron lafiyarsa.

title: 1 Tarihi 11:26
content: 26 Jarumawan nan su ne, Asahel ɗan’uwan Yowab, Elhanan ɗan Dodo daga Betlehem,

title: 1 Tarihi 11:27
content: 27 Shammot mutumin Haror, Helez mutumin Felon,

title: 1 Tarihi 11:28
content: 28 Ira ɗan Ikkesh daga Tekowa, Abiyezer daga Anatot,

title: 1 Tarihi 11:29
content: 29 Sibbekai mutumin Husha, Ilai mutumin Aho,

title: 1 Tarihi 11:30
content: 30 Maharai mutumin Netofa, Heled ɗan Ba’ana mutumin Netofa,

title: 1 Tarihi 11:31
content: 31 Ittai ɗan Ribai daga Gibeya a Benyamin, Benahiya mutumin Firaton,

title: 1 Tarihi 11:32
content: 32 Hurai daga kogunan Ga’ash, Abiyel mutumin Arba,

title: 1 Tarihi 11:33
content: 33 Azmawet mutumin Harum, Eliyaba mutumin Sha’albo,

title: 1 Tarihi 11:34
content: 34 ’ya’yan Hashem mutumin Gizon maza, Yonatan ɗan Shageye mutumin Harar,

title: 1 Tarihi 11:35
content: 35 Ahiyam ɗan Sakar mutumin Harar, Elifal ɗan Ur,

title: 1 Tarihi 11:36
content: 36 Hefer mutumin Mekerat, Ahiya mutumin Felon,

title: 1 Tarihi 11:37
content: 37 Hezro mutumin Karmel, Na’arai ɗan Ezbai,

title: 1 Tarihi 11:38
content: 38 Yowel ɗan’uwan Natan, Mibhar ɗan Hagiri,

title: 1 Tarihi 11:39
content: 39 Zelek mutumin Ammon Naharai Baroti, mai ɗaukar kayan yaƙin Yowab ɗan Zeruhiya,

title: 1 Tarihi 11:40
content: 40 Ira mutumin Itra, Gareb mutumin Itra,

title: 1 Tarihi 11:41
content: 41 Uriya mutumin Hitti Zabad ɗan Alai,

title: 1 Tarihi 11:42
content: 42 Adina ɗan Shiza mutumin Ruben, wanda shi ne babba na mutanen Ruben, kuma talatin suna tare da shi,

title: 1 Tarihi 11:43
content: 43 Hanan ɗan Ma’aka, Yoshafat mutumin Mit,

title: 1 Tarihi 11:44
content: 44 Uzziya mutumin Ashtarot, Shama da Yehiyel ’ya’yan Hotam mutumin Arower maza,

title: 1 Tarihi 11:45
content: 45 Yediyayel ɗan Shimri, ɗan’uwansa Yoha mutumin Tiz,

title: 1 Tarihi 11:46
content: 46 Eliyel mutumin Ma’aha, Yeribai da Yoshawiya ’ya’yan Elna’am maza, Itma mutumin Mowab,

title: 1 Tarihi 11:47
content: 47 Eliyel, Obed da Ya’asiyel mutumin Mezob.

title: 1 Tarihi 12:1
content: 1 Waɗannan su ne mutanen da suka zo wurin Dawuda a Ziklag, yayinda aka kore shi daga gaban Shawulu ɗan Kish (suna cikin jarumawan da suka taimake shi a yaƙi;

title: 1 Tarihi 12:2
content: 2 suna da baka suna kuma iya harba kibiya, ko majajjawa da hannun dama ko na hagu; su ’yan’uwan Shawulu ne daga kabilar Benyamin):

title: 1 Tarihi 12:3
content: 3 Ahiyezer babbansu da Yowash ’ya’yan Shema’a maza daga Gibeya; Yeziyel da Felet ’ya’yan Azmawet; Beraka, Yehu daga Anatot,

title: 1 Tarihi 12:4
content: 4 da Ishmahiya daga Gibeyon, wani jarumi a cikin Talatin nan, wanda shi ne shugaban Talatin; Irmiya, Yahaziyel, Yohanan, Yozabad daga Gedera,

title: 1 Tarihi 12:5
content: 5 Eluzai, Yerimot, Beyaliya, Shemariya da Shefatiya daga Haruf;

title: 1 Tarihi 12:6
content: 6 Elkana, Isshiya, Azarel, Yoyezer da Yashobeyam daga Kora;

title: 1 Tarihi 12:7
content: 7 da Yoyela da Zebadiya ’ya’yan Yeroham maza daga Gedor.

title: 1 Tarihi 12:8
content: 8 Sai waɗansu mutanen Gad suka koma suna goyon bayan Dawuda suka kuma haɗa kai da shi a kagararsa a hamada. Su ƙwararrun mayaƙa ne, a shirye don yaƙi, kuma suna iya riƙe garkuwa da māshi. Fuskokinsu kamar fuskoki zakoki, kuma suna da sauri kamar bareyi a kan duwatsu.

title: 1 Tarihi 12:9
content: 9 Ezer shi ne babba, Obadiya shi ne mai binsa a shugabanci, Eliyab na uku,

title: 1 Tarihi 12:10
content: 10 Mismanna na huɗu, Irmiya na biyar,

title: 1 Tarihi 12:11
content: 11 Attai na shida, Eliyel na bakwai,

title: 1 Tarihi 12:12
content: 12 Yohanan na takwas, Elzabad na tara,

title: 1 Tarihi 12:13
content: 13 Irmiya na goma da kuma Makbannai na goma sha ɗaya.

title: 1 Tarihi 12:14
content: 14 Waɗannan mutanen Gad shugabannin mayaƙa ne; ƙarami a cikinsu zai iya ƙara da mutum ɗari, kuma babba a cikin zai iya ƙara da dubu.

title: 1 Tarihi 12:15
content: 15 Su ne suka haye Urdun a wata na farko sa’ad da kogin ya yi ambaliya, suka kuma kori duk mai rai a kwarin, na wajen gabas da na wajen yamma.

title: 1 Tarihi 12:16
content: 16 Sauran mutanen Benyamin da waɗansu mutanen Yahuda su ma suka zo wurin Dawuda a kagararsa.

title: 1 Tarihi 12:17
content: 17 Sai Dawuda ya fita don yă tarye su, ya kuma ce musu, “In kun zo wurina da salama, don ku taimake ni, to, ina a shirye in bar ku ku haɗa kai tare da ni. Amma in kun zo don ku bashe ni ga abokan gābana sa’ad da hannuwana ba su da laifi a rikici, bari Allah na kakanninmu yă duba yă kuma shari’anta ku.”

title: 1 Tarihi 12:18
content: 18 Sai Ruhu ya sauko a kan Amasai, shugaban Talatin nan, sai ya ce, “Mu naka ne, ya Dawuda! Muna tare da kai, ya ɗan Yesse! Nasara, nasara gare ka, nasara kuma ga waɗanda suke taimakonka. Gama Allahnka zai taimake ka.” Saboda haka Dawuda ya karɓe su ya kuma mai da su shugabannin ƙungiyoyin maharansa.

title: 1 Tarihi 12:19
content: 19 Waɗansu mutanen Manasse suka haɗa kai da Dawuda sa’ad da ya tafi tare da Filistiyawa don yă yaƙi Shawulu (Shi da mutanensa ba su taimaki Filistiyawa ba domin bayan shawarwari, shugabanninsu suka salame shi. Sun ce, “Za mu biya da kawunanmu in ya koma ga maigidansa Shawulu.”)

title: 1 Tarihi 12:20
content: 20 Da Dawuda ya tafi Ziklag, waɗannan mutanen Manasse ne suka haɗa kai da shi. Adna, Yozabad, Yediyayel, Mika’ilu, Yozabad, Elihu da Zilletai, shugabannin ƙungiyoyi na dubu a cikin Manasse.

title: 1 Tarihi 12:21
content: 21 Suka taimaki Dawuda a kan ƙungiyoyin hari, gama dukansu jarumawa ne sosai, kuma su shugabanni ne a cikin mayaƙansa.

title: 1 Tarihi 12:22
content: 22 Kowace rana mutane suka riƙa zuwa don su taimaki Dawuda, sai da ya kasance da runduna mai girma, kamar mayaƙan Allah.

title: 1 Tarihi 12:23
content: 23 Ga yawan mutanen shiryayyu don yaƙi waɗanda suka zo wurin Dawuda a Hebron don su mai da mulkin Shawulu gare shi, yadda Ubangiji ya faɗa.

title: 1 Tarihi 12:24
content: 24 Mutanen Yahuda, masu riƙe garkuwa da māshi, su 6,800 shiryayyu don yaƙi;

title: 1 Tarihi 12:25
content: 25 mutanen Simeyon, jarumawa shiryayyu don yaƙi, su 7,100;

title: 1 Tarihi 12:26
content: 26 mutanen Lawi, su 4,600,

title: 1 Tarihi 12:27
content: 27 haɗe da Yehohiyada, shugaban iyalin Haruna tare da mutane 3,700,

title: 1 Tarihi 12:28
content: 28 da Zadok, matashi jarumi sosai, tare da shugabanni su 22 daga iyalinsa;

title: 1 Tarihi 12:29
content: 29 mutanen Benyamin, ’yan’uwan Shawulu, su 3,000, yawanci waɗanda suke biyayya ga gidan Shawulu sai lokacin;

title: 1 Tarihi 12:30
content: 30 mutanen Efraim, jarumawa, sanannu cikin gidajensu, su 20 800;

title: 1 Tarihi 12:31
content: 31 mutanen rabin kabilar Manasse, sanannu da sunaye suka zo suka mai da Dawuda sarki, su 18,000;

title: 1 Tarihi 12:32
content: 32 mutanen Issakar, masu fahimtar lokuta suka kuma san abin da ya kamata Isra’ila ya yi, manya 200, tare da danginsu a ƙarƙashin shugabancinsu;

title: 1 Tarihi 12:33
content: 33 mutanen Zebulun, ƙwararru sojoji shiryayyu don yaƙi da kowane irin makami, suka zo don su taimaki Dawuda da zuciya ɗaya, su 50,000;

title: 1 Tarihi 12:34
content: 34 mutanen Naftali su 1,000 shugabanni, tare da mutane 37,000 masu riƙe garkuwa da masu;

title: 1 Tarihi 12:35
content: 35 mutanen Dan, shiryayyu don yaƙi, su 28,600;

title: 1 Tarihi 12:36
content: 36 mutanen Asher, ƙwararrun sojoji shiryayyu don yaƙi, su 40,000;

title: 1 Tarihi 12:37
content: 37 kuma daga gabashin Urdun, mutanen Ruben, Gad da kuma rabin kabilar Manasse, masu kayan yaƙi iri-iri, su 120,000.

title: 1 Tarihi 12:38
content: 38 Dukan waɗannan mayaƙa ne waɗanda suka ba da kansu da yardar rai su yi hidima. Suka zo Hebron da cikakken niyya don su naɗa Dawuda sarki a bisa dukan Isra’ila. Duka sauran Isra’ilawa su ma suka goyi baya a naɗa Dawuda sarki.

title: 1 Tarihi 12:39
content: 39 Mutanen suka yi kwana uku a can tare da Dawuda, suna ci suna sha, gama iyalansu sun yi musu tanadi.

title: 1 Tarihi 12:40
content: 40 Haka ma, maƙwabtansu daga nesa har Issakar, Zebulun da Naftali suka zo suka kawo abinci a kan jakuna, raƙuma, alfadarai da shanu. Akwai tanadin mai yawa na gari, kauɗar ɓaure, nonnan busassun ’ya’yan inabi, ruwan inabi, mai, shanu da tumaki. Duk an yi haka don a nuna farin ciki ƙwarai a cikin dukan ƙasar Isra’ila.

title: 1 Tarihi 13:1
content: 1 Sai Dawuda ya tattauna da kowane ɗaya daga cikin shugabanninsa, shugabannin sojoji na dubu-dubu da na ɗari-ɗari.

title: 1 Tarihi 13:2
content: 2 Sa’an nan ya ce wa dukan taron Isra’ila, “In ya yi muku kyau kuma in nufin Ubangiji Allahnmu ne, bari mu aika da saƙo nesa da kuma ko’ina zuwa ga sauran ’yan’uwanmu a duk iyakokin Isra’ila, da kuma zuwa ga firistoci da Lawiyawa waɗanda suke tare da su a garuruwansu da makiyayansu, su zo wurinmu.

title: 1 Tarihi 13:3
content: 3 Bari mu ɗauko akwatin alkawarin Allahnmu mu kawo wurinmu, gama ba mu neme shi a lokacin mulkin Shawulu ba.”

title: 1 Tarihi 13:4
content: 4 Dukan taron jama’a suka yarda su yi haka, domin ya yi daidai ga dukan mutane.

title: 1 Tarihi 13:5
content: 5 Saboda haka Dawuda ya tattara dukan Isra’ilawa, daga Kogin Shihor a Masar zuwa Lebo Hamat, don su kawo akwatin alkawarin Allah daga Kiriyat Yeyarim.

title: 1 Tarihi 13:6
content: 6 Dawuda da dukan Isra’ilawa tare da shi suka tafi Ba’ala na Yahuda (Kiriyat Yeyarim) don su haura daga can su kawo akwatin alkawarin Allah Ubangiji, wanda yake zama tsakanin kerubobi, akwatin alkawarin da ake kira da Sunan.

title: 1 Tarihi 13:7
content: 7 Suka ɗauki akwatin alkawarin Allah daga gidan Abinadab a kan sabon keken shanu, Uzza da Ahiyo ne suke lura da shi.

title: 1 Tarihi 13:8
content: 8 Dawuda da dukan Isra’ilawa suka yi shagali da dukan ƙarfinsu a gaban Allah, tare da waƙoƙi da garayu, molaye, ganguna, kuge da ƙahoni.

title: 1 Tarihi 13:9
content: 9 Sa’ad da suka kai masussukar Kidon, Uzza ya miƙa hannunsa don yă gyara akwatin alkawarin, gama shanun sun yi tuntuɓe.

title: 1 Tarihi 13:10
content: 10 Sai fushin Ubangiji ya ƙuna a kan Uzza, ya kuma buge shi domin ya sa hannunsa a kan akwatin alkawarin. Sai ya mutu a can a gaban Allah.

title: 1 Tarihi 13:11
content: 11 Ran Dawuda ya ɓace domin Ubangiji ya husata a kan Uzza, kuma har wa yau ana ce da wannan wuri Ferez Uzza.

title: 1 Tarihi 13:12
content: 12 Dawuda ya ji tsoron Allah a wannan rana ya kuma yi tambaya, “Yaya zan taɓa kawo akwatin alkawarin Allah gare ni?”

title: 1 Tarihi 13:13
content: 13 Don haka bai ɗauki akwatin alkawarin ya kasance tare da shi a Birnin Dawuda ba. A maimakon haka, ya kai shi gidan Obed-Edom mutumin Gat.

title: 1 Tarihi 13:14
content: 14 Akwatin Alkawarin Allah ya zauna tare da iyalin Obed-Edom a gidansa wata uku, Ubangiji kuwa ya albarkaci gidan Obed-Edom da kome da yake da shi.

title: 1 Tarihi 14:1
content: 1 To, fa, Hiram sarkin Taya ya aika da ’yan aika zuwa wurin Dawuda, tare da gumaguman al’ul, maginan duwatsu da kafintoci, don su gina wa Dawuda fada.

title: 1 Tarihi 14:2
content: 2 Dawuda kuwa ya san cewa Ubangiji ya kafa shi a matsayin sarki a bisa Isra’ila kuma cewa an ɗaukaka mulkinsa saboda mutanensa Isra’ila.

title: 1 Tarihi 14:3
content: 3 A Urushalima, Dawuda ya ƙara auren waɗansu mata, ya kuma zama mahaifin ƙarin ’ya’yan maza da mata.

title: 1 Tarihi 14:4
content: 4 Ga sunayen yaran da aka haifa masa a can. Shammuwa, Shobab, Natan, Solomon,

title: 1 Tarihi 14:5
content: 5 Ibhar, Elishuwa, Elfelet,

title: 1 Tarihi 14:6
content: 6 Noga, Nefeg, Yafiya,

title: 1 Tarihi 14:7
content: 7 Elishama, Beyeliyada da Elifelet.

title: 1 Tarihi 14:8
content: 8 Sa’ad da Filistiyawa suka ji an naɗa Dawuda sarki a bisa dukan Isra’ila, sai suka haura da cikakken mayaƙa don su neme shi, amma Dawuda ya ji game da wannan ya kuwa fita don yă ƙara da su.

title: 1 Tarihi 14:9
content: 9 To, fa, Filistiyawa suka zo suka kai wa Kwarin Refayim hari;

title: 1 Tarihi 14:10
content: 10 sai Dawuda ya roƙi Allah ya ce, “In tafi in yaƙi Filistiyawa? Za ka ba da su gare ni?” Ubangiji ya amsa masa ya ce, “Ka tafi, zan ba da su gare ka.”

title: 1 Tarihi 14:11
content: 11 Saboda haka Dawuda da mutanensa suka haura zuwa Ba’al-Ferazim, a can kuwa suka ci Filistiyawa da yaƙi. Sai ya ce, “Kamar yadda ruwa kan raraki ƙasa, haka Allah ya raraki abokan gābana ta wurin hannuna.” Saboda haka aka kira wurin Ba’al-Ferazim.

title: 1 Tarihi 14:12
content: 12 Filistiyawa suka yashe allolinsu, Dawuda kuma ya ba da umarnai a ƙone su a wuta.

title: 1 Tarihi 14:13
content: 13 Filistiyawa suka sāke kai hari wa kwarin;

title: 1 Tarihi 14:14
content: 14 sai Dawuda ya sāke roƙi Allah, Allah kuwa ya amsa masa, “Kada ka tafi kai tsaye, amma ka yi zobe kewaye da su, ka kuma fāɗa musu a gaban itatuwan tsamiya.

title: 1 Tarihi 14:15
content: 15 Da zarar ka ji motsin takawa a sama itatuwan tsamiya, ka fita don yaƙi, domin wannan zai nuna cewa Allah ya fita a gabanka don yă bugi mayaƙan Filistiyawa.”

title: 1 Tarihi 14:16
content: 16 Saboda haka Dawuda ya yi kamar yadda Allah ya umarce shi, suka kuma bugi mayaƙan Filistiyawa, tun daga Gibeyon har zuwa Gezer.

title: 1 Tarihi 14:17
content: 17 Sai sunan Dawuda ya bazu ko’ina a ƙasar, Ubangiji kuwa ya sa dukan al’ummai suka ji tsoronsa.

title: 1 Tarihi 15:1
content: 1 Bayan Dawuda ya yi gine-gine wa kansa a Birnin Dawuda, sai ya shirya wuri domin akwatin alkawarin Allah, ya kuma kafa tenti dominsa.

title: 1 Tarihi 15:2
content: 2 Sa’an nan Dawuda ya ce, “Babu wani sai ko Lawiyawa kaɗai za su ɗauka akwatin alkawarin Allah, gama Ubangiji ya zaɓe su su ɗauka akwatin alkawarin Ubangiji su kuma yi hidima a gabansa har abada.”

title: 1 Tarihi 15:3
content: 3 Dawuda ya tattara dukan Isra’ila a Urushalima don su haura da akwatin alkawarin Ubangiji zuwa wurin da aka shirya dominsa.

title: 1 Tarihi 15:4
content: 4 Ya tattara zuriyar Haruna a wuri ɗaya da kuma Lawiyawa.

title: 1 Tarihi 15:5
content: 5 Daga zuriyar Kohat, Uriyel shugaba da dangi 120;

title: 1 Tarihi 15:6
content: 6 daga zuriyar Merari Asahiya shugaba da dangi 220;

title: 1 Tarihi 15:7
content: 7 daga zuriyar Gershom, Yowel shugaba da dangi 130;

title: 1 Tarihi 15:8
content: 8 daga zuriyar Elizafan, Shemahiya shugaba da dangi 200;

title: 1 Tarihi 15:9
content: 9 daga zuriyar Hebron, Eliyel shugaba da dangi 80;

title: 1 Tarihi 15:10
content: 10 daga zuriyar Uzziyel, Amminadab shugaba da dangi 112.

title: 1 Tarihi 15:11
content: 11 Sa’an nan Dawuda ya kira Zadok da Abiyatar, firistoci, tare da Uriyel, Asahiya, Yowel, Shemahiya, Eliyel da Amminadab, Lawiyawa.

title: 1 Tarihi 15:12
content: 12 Ya ce musu, “Ku ne kawunan iyalan Lawiyawa; ku da ’yan’uwanku Lawiyawa, sai ku tsarkake kanku ku hauro da akwatin alkawarin Ubangiji, Allah na Isra’ila, zuwa wurin da na shirya dominsa.

title: 1 Tarihi 15:13
content: 13 Domin ku, Lawiyawa ba ku haura da shi da farko ba ne ya sa Ubangiji Allahnmu ya husata a kanmu. Ba mu tambaye shi game da yadda za mu yi shi a hanyar da aka ƙayyade ba.”

title: 1 Tarihi 15:14
content: 14 Saboda haka firistoci da Lawiyawa suka tsarkake kansu don su hauro da akwatin alkawarin Ubangiji, Allah na Isra’ila.

title: 1 Tarihi 15:15
content: 15 Sai Lawiyawa suka ɗauki akwatin alkawarin Allah da sanduna a kafaɗunsu, kamar yadda Musa ya umarta bisa ga maganar Ubangiji.

title: 1 Tarihi 15:16
content: 16 Dawuda ya faɗa wa shugabannin Lawiyawa su sa ’yan’uwansu su zama mawaƙa don su rera waƙoƙi masu farin ciki, da kayayyakin bushe-bushe, da kaɗe-kaɗe, molaye, garayu da ganguna.

title: 1 Tarihi 15:17
content: 17 Saboda haka Lawiyawa suka zaɓi Heman ɗan Yowel, da Asaf ɗan Berekiya daga cikin ’yan’uwansu. Daga iyalin Merari kuma aka zaɓi Etan ɗan Kushahiya.

title: 1 Tarihi 15:18
content: 18 Tare da su kuma ’yan’uwansa da suke biye bisa ga matsayi. Wato, Zakariya, Ya’aziyel, Shemiramot, Yehiyel, Unni, Eliyab, Ben, Ma’asehiya, Mattitiya, Elifelehu, Miknehiya, Obed-Edom da Yehiyel, matsaran ƙofofi.

title: 1 Tarihi 15:19
content: 19 Mawaƙan nan Heman, Asaf da Etan, ne za su buga kugen tagulla.

title: 1 Tarihi 15:20
content: 20 Zakariya, Aziyel, Shemiramot, Yehiyel, Unni, Eliyab, Ma’asehiya da Benahiya, ne za su kaɗa molaye masu murya sama-sama, bisa ga alamot.

title: 1 Tarihi 15:21
content: 21 Mattitiya, Elifelehu, Miknehiya, Obed-Edom, Yehiyel da Azaziya, ne za su ja garayu masu murya ƙasa-ƙasa bisa ga sheminit.

title: 1 Tarihi 15:22
content: 22 Kenaniya, shugaban Lawiyawa, shi ne mai bi da waƙoƙi. Wannan hakkinsa ne, gama shi gwani ne a wannan fanni.

title: 1 Tarihi 15:23
content: 23 Berekiya da Elkana, ne za su zama masu lura da ƙofofi domin akwatin alkawarin.

title: 1 Tarihi 15:24
content: 24 Shebaniya, Yoshafat, Netanel, Amasai, Zakariya, Benahiya da Eliyezer firistoci, su ne za su busa ƙahoni a gaban akwatin alkawarin Allah. Obed-Edom da Yehiya su ma za su zama masu lura da ƙofofi domin akwatin alkawarin.

title: 1 Tarihi 15:25
content: 25 Sai Dawuda da dattawan Isra’ila da shugabannin ƙungiyoyi dubu suka haura don su kawo akwatin alkawarin Ubangiji daga gidan Obed-Edom, da farin ciki.

title: 1 Tarihi 15:26
content: 26 Domin Allah ya taimaki Lawiyawan da suke ɗaukar akwatin alkawarin Ubangiji, aka miƙa hadayar bijimai bakwai da raguna bakwai.

title: 1 Tarihi 15:27
content: 27 To, fa, Dawuda yana saye da kyakkyawar rigar lilin, kamar yadda dukan Lawiyawa waɗanda suke ɗaukar akwatin alkawarin suka sa, da kuma yadda mawaƙa, da Kenaniya, wanda yake bi da waƙar mawaƙan ya sa. Dawuda kuma ya sa efod lilin.

title: 1 Tarihi 15:28
content: 28 Sai dukan Isra’ila suka kawo akwatin alkawarin Ubangiji da sowa, da ƙarar ƙahonin raguna da busan ƙahoni, da na ganguna, suna kuma kaɗa molaye da garayu.

title: 1 Tarihi 15:29
content: 29 Yayinda akwatin alkawarin Ubangiji yake shiga Birnin Dawuda, Mikal ’yar Shawulu ta leƙa daga taga. Sa’ad da ta ga Sarki Dawuda yana rawa yana shagali, sai ta rena masa wayo a zuciyarta.

title: 1 Tarihi 16:1
content: 1 Suka fa kawo akwatin alkawarin Allah, suka sa a cikin tentin da Dawuda ya kafa dominsa, suka kuma miƙa hadayun ƙonawa da hadayu na salama a gaban Allah.

title: 1 Tarihi 16:2
content: 2 Bayan Dawuda ya gama miƙa hadayu na ƙonawa da hadayu na salama, sai ya albarkaci mutane a cikin sunan Ubangiji.

title: 1 Tarihi 16:3
content: 3 Sa’an nan ya ba da dunƙulen burodi da wainar dabino da kuma kauɗar zabibi ga kowane mutumin Isra’ila namiji da ta mace.

title: 1 Tarihi 16:4
content: 4 Ya sa Lawiyawa su yi hidima a gaban akwatin alkawarin Ubangiji, su ɗaukaka, su gode, su kuma yabi Ubangiji, Allah na Isra’ila.

title: 1 Tarihi 16:5
content: 5 Asaf shi ne babba, sai Zakariya na biye, sa’an nan Ya’aziyel, Shemiramot, Yehiyel, Mattitiya, Eliyab, Benahiya, Obed-Edom da Yehiyel. Su ne za su kaɗa molaye, da garayu, Asaf kuwa zai buga ganguna,

title: 1 Tarihi 16:6
content: 6 Benahiya da Yahaziyel firistoci za su busa ƙahoni kullum a gaban akwatin alkawarin Allah.

title: 1 Tarihi 16:7
content: 7 A wannan rana, da farko, Dawuda ya sa Asaf da ’yan’uwansa su rera wannan zabura ta yabo ga Ubangiji.

title: 1 Tarihi 16:8
content: 8 Ku yi godiya ga Ubangiji, ku yi shelar sunansa; ku sanar a cikin al’ummai abin da ya yi.

title: 1 Tarihi 16:9
content: 9 Ku rera gare shi, ku rera yabo gare shi; ku faɗa dukan ayyukan banmamakinsa.

title: 1 Tarihi 16:10
content: 10 Ku ɗaukaka a cikin sunansa mai tsarki bari zukatan waɗanda suke neman Ubangiji su yi farin ciki.

title: 1 Tarihi 16:11
content: 11 Ku dogara ga Ubangiji da kuma ƙarfinsa; ku nemi fuskarsa kullum.

title: 1 Tarihi 16:12
content: 12 Ku tuna ayyukan banmamakin da ya aikata, mu’ujizansa da kuma hukuntai da ya yanke,

title: 1 Tarihi 16:13
content: 13 Ya ku zuriyar Isra’ila bayinsa, Ya ku ’ya’yan Yaƙub maza, zaɓaɓɓunsa.

title: 1 Tarihi 16:14
content: 14 Shi ne Ubangiji Allahnmu; hukuntansa suna a cikin dukan duniya.

title: 1 Tarihi 16:15
content: 15 Yakan tuna da alkawarinsa har abada, maganar da ya umarta, har tsararraki dubu,

title: 1 Tarihi 16:16
content: 16 alkawarin da ya yi wa Ibrahim rantsuwar da ya yi ga Ishaku.

title: 1 Tarihi 16:17
content: 17 Ya tabbatar da shi ga Yaƙub kamar ƙa’ida, ga Isra’ila kamar madawwamin alkawari.

title: 1 Tarihi 16:18
content: 18 “Gare ka zan ba da ƙasar Kan’ana kamar rabon da za ka gāda.”

title: 1 Tarihi 16:19
content: 19 Sa’ad da suke kima, kima sosai, da kuma baƙi a cikinta,

title: 1 Tarihi 16:20
content: 20 suka yi ta yawo daga al’umma zuwa al’umma, daga wannan mulki zuwa wancan.

title: 1 Tarihi 16:21
content: 21 Bai bar wani ya zalunce su ba; saboda su ya tsawata wa sarakuna.

title: 1 Tarihi 16:22
content: 22 “Kada ku taɓa shafaffuna; kada ku yi wa annabawana lahani.”

title: 1 Tarihi 16:23
content: 23 Ku rera ga Ubangiji, ku duniya duka; ku yi shelar cetonsa kowace rana.

title: 1 Tarihi 16:24
content: 24 Ku furta ɗaukakarsa a cikin al’ummai, ayyukansa masu al’ajabai a cikin mutane.

title: 1 Tarihi 16:25
content: 25 Gama Ubangiji mai girma ne ya kuma cancanci yabo; dole a ji tsoronsa fiye da dukan alloli.

title: 1 Tarihi 16:26
content: 26 Gama dukan allolin al’ummai gumaka ne, amma Ubangiji ya yi sammai.

title: 1 Tarihi 16:27
content: 27 Daraja da ɗaukaka suna a gabansa; ƙarfi da farin ciki suna a wurin zamansa.

title: 1 Tarihi 16:28
content: 28 Ku yabi Ubangiji, ku iyalan al’ummai, ku yabi ɗaukaka da ƙarfin Ubangiji,

title: 1 Tarihi 16:29
content: 29 ku ba wa Ubangiji ɗaukakar da ta dace da sunansa. Ku kawo hadaya ku kuma zo gabansa; ku yi wa Ubangiji sujada cikin darajar tsarkinsa.

title: 1 Tarihi 16:30
content: 30 Ku yi rawar jiki a gabansa, ya ku duniya duka! Duniya ta kahu sosai; ba za tă jijjigu ba.

title: 1 Tarihi 16:31
content: 31 Bari sammai su yi farin ciki, bari duniya tă yi murna; bari su ce a cikin al’ummai, “Ubangiji yana mulki!”

title: 1 Tarihi 16:32
content: 32 Bari teku da kome da yake cikinsa su yi ruri; bari gonaki da kome a cikinsu su yi farin ciki!

title: 1 Tarihi 16:33
content: 33 Sa’an nan itatuwan jeji za su rera, za su rera don farin ciki a gaban Ubangiji, gama ya zo don yă hukunta duniya.

title: 1 Tarihi 16:34
content: 34 Ku yi godiya ga Ubangiji, gama shi nagari ne; ƙaunarsa madawwamiya ce.

title: 1 Tarihi 16:35
content: 35 Ku yi kuka, ku ce, “Cece mu, ya Allah Mai Cetonmu; tara mu ka kuma cece mu daga al’ummai, don mu yi godiya ga sunanka mai tsarki, don mu ɗaukaka a cikin yabonka.”

title: 1 Tarihi 16:36
content: 36 Yabi Ubangiji, Allah na Isra’ila, daga madawwami zuwa madawwami. Sai dukan mutane suka ce, “Amin.” Suka kuma “Yabi Ubangiji.”

title: 1 Tarihi 16:37
content: 37 Dawuda ya bar Asaf da ’yan’uwansa a gaban akwatin alkawarin Ubangiji don su yi hidima a can kullum, bisa ga tsari na kowace rana.

title: 1 Tarihi 16:38
content: 38 Ya kuma bar Obed-Edom da ’yan’uwansa sittin da takwas don su yi hidima tare. Obed-Edom ɗan Yedutun da Hosa kuma, su ne matsaran ƙofofi.

title: 1 Tarihi 16:39
content: 39 Dawuda ya bar Zadok firist da ’yan’uwansa firistoci a gaban tabanakul na Ubangiji a tudun da yake a Gibeyon

title: 1 Tarihi 16:40
content: 40 don su miƙa hadayun ƙonawa ga Ubangiji a kan bagaden hadaya ta ƙonawa kullum, da safe da kuma yamma, bisa ga kome da yake a rubutacce a cikin Dokar Ubangiji, da ya ba wa Isra’ila.

title: 1 Tarihi 16:41
content: 41 Tare da su akwai Heman da Yedutun da sauran waɗannan zaɓaɓɓun da aka rubuta sunansu don yin godiya ga Ubangiji, “gama ƙaunarsa madawwamiya ce har abada.”

title: 1 Tarihi 16:42
content: 42 Heman da Yedutun su ne da hakkin busa ƙahoni da kaɗa kuge da sauran kayan bushe-bushe da na kaɗe-kaɗe, waɗanda ake amfani da su lokacin da ake rera waƙoƙi masu tsarki. ’Ya’yan Yedutun maza, su aka ba wa aikin tsaron ƙofa.

title: 1 Tarihi 16:43
content: 43 Sa’an nan dukan mutanen suka tashi, kowa ya koma gidansa, Dawuda ya koma gida yă sa wa iyalinsa albarka.

title: 1 Tarihi 17:1
content: 1 Bayan Dawuda ya zauna a fadansa, sai ya ce wa annabi Natan, “Ga ni, ina zama a fadar da aka yi da al’ul, yayinda akwatin alkawarin Ubangiji yana a ƙarƙashin tenti.”

title: 1 Tarihi 17:2
content: 2 Natan ya amsa wa Dawuda ya ce, “Duk abin da kake tunani a zuciya, ka yi, gama Allah yana tare da kai.”

title: 1 Tarihi 17:3
content: 3 A daren nan maganar Allah ta zo wa Natan cewa,

title: 1 Tarihi 17:4
content: 4 “Ka tafi ka faɗa wa bawana Dawuda, ‘Ga abin da Ubangiji ya ce ba kai ba ne za ka gida mini gidan da zan zauna a ciki.

title: 1 Tarihi 17:5
content: 5 Ban taɓa zama a gida daga ranar da na fito da Isra’ila daga Masar ba har wa yau. Na yi ta yawo daga gefen da aka kafa tenti zuwa wani, daga wannan wuri zuwa wancan.

title: 1 Tarihi 17:6
content: 6 Duk inda na tafi tare da Isra’ilawa, na taɓa ce wa wani daga cikin shugabanninsu waɗanda na umarta su yi kiwon mutanena, “Don me ba ku gida mini gidan al’ul ba?” ’

title: 1 Tarihi 17:7
content: 7 “Yanzu, ka faɗa wa bawana Dawuda, ‘Ga abin da Ubangiji Maɗaukaki ya ce, na ɗauke ka daga makiyaya da kuma daga bin garke, don ka zama mai mulki a bisa mutanena Isra’ila.

title: 1 Tarihi 17:8
content: 8 Na kasance tare da kai ko’ina ka tafi, na kuma yanke dukan abokan gābanka a gabanka. Yanzu zan sa sunanka kamar sunayen mutane mafi girma na duniya.

title: 1 Tarihi 17:9
content: 9 Zan kuma tanada wuri domin mutanena Isra’ila, zan kuma kafa su saboda za su kasance da gidan kansu ba kuwa za a ƙara damunsu ba. Mugayen mutane ba za su ƙara zaluntar su ba, yadda suka yi da farko

title: 1 Tarihi 17:10
content: 10 da kuma suka yi tun lokacin da na sa shugabanni a bisa mutanen Isra’ila. Zan rinjaye dukan abokan gābanka. “ ‘Na furta maka cewa Ubangiji zai gina maka gida,

title: 1 Tarihi 17:11
